raw.title: Gestionnaire de projet et produit - IA
raw.excerpt: Nous croyons que les meilleures conditions de travail inspirent les meilleurs résultats, et notre équipe le prouve, année après année, auprès de nos clients et dans l'ensemble de l'industrie.
raw.description:
Nous croyons que les meilleures conditions de travail inspirent les meilleurs résultats, et notre équipe le prouve, année après année, auprès de nos clients et dans l'ensemble de l'industrie.

Chez Thirdbridge, nous créons des applications et des solutions logicielles sur mesure depuis plus d'une décennie. Au-delà du code, nous sommes fiers de réunir des passionné·es de technologie au cœur d'une culture inégalable avec qui nous imaginons des expériences numériques que les utilisateurs aiment pour de vrai.

Le·la PM/PO IA sera responsable de coordonner les projets. En travaillant conjointement avec les équipes de design et de développement, il·elle combinera ses compétences en gestion de produit et de projets agiles pour livrer des solutions qui répondent aux besoins clients, et qui se testent avant même d'être construites.

Les principales responsabilités

  • Recevoir, évaluer et gérer les demandes clients en assurant un constant alignement avec la stratégie produit;
  • Assurer un rôle de conseil dans la relation client;
  • Prototyper rapidement des idées produit avec des outils d'IA générative pour valider des hypothèses avant d'impliquer les équipes de développement;
  • Utiliser l'IA activement au quotidien : générer du code fonctionnel, rédiger des specs, créer des maquettes, automatiser des tâches;
  • Conseil stratégique en transformation numérique et IA. Diagnostiquer la maturité d'un client, cartographier son écosystème et livrer une feuille de route de transformation priorisée.
  • Organiser et animer des ateliers avec le client et l’équipe: Mener des entrevues et synthétiser les constats en présentations claires pour des décideurs.
  • Mettre en place des objectifs mesurables, analyser les données et les KPIs et assurer une rétroaction à l'équipe;
  • Gérer les budgets et les échéanciers liés aux projets et prendre les décisions adéquates lorsqu'ils sont impactés;
  • Gérer et prioriser le backlog produit et design en collaboration avec le chef d'équipe (rédaction d'epics,user stories, etc.);
  • Superviser le processus d'assurance qualité tout en y participant activement;
  • Assurer le suivi du cycle de vie du produit, de la conception à la livraison et à la maintenance;
  • Garantir un alignement constant entre les livrables et la vision produit.

Finalement, nous cherchons quelqu'un qui n'attend pas que tout soit parfait pour tester une idée, quelqu'un qui prototype avant de planifier et propose des solutions proactives plutôt que réactives. Quelqu’un qui a du goût et de l’expérience avec des clients mais qui est aussi technique. Tu relèveras de la Directrice produit.

Le profil recherché

  • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projets et/ou gestion de produits numériques;
  • Expérience pertinente dans le domaine du développement logiciel;
  • Habileté à gérer des budgets, des ressources et des échéanciers;
  • Familiarité avec la méthodologieScrumet les pratiques agiles;
  • Bonne connaissance de nos outils de gestion (ex. Jira, Harvest, Forecast, etc.);
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication pour assurer la collaboration et l'alignement entre les clients et les équipes;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit;
  • Tu utilises activement l'IA dans ton travail;
  • Tu es à l'aise avec le vibe coding : tu sais diriger un agent de développement IA pour produire des prototypes fonctionnels rapidement, et tu comprends ce que tu génères assez pour en valider la qualité;
  • Tu connais bien les concepts de base du design UX/UI et de l'outil Figma;

Un gros plus si :

  • Tu as une expertise en stratégie numérique et analyse des données(analytics);
  • Tu as une connaissance de l'industrie du commerce de détail, des programmes de fidélisation, des stratégies marketing propres à cette industrie et de la ludification de produits numériques;
  • Tu as un intérêt marqué pour les applications transactionnelles et l'expérience client en contexte de vente au détail.

Les avantages de travailler avec nous

  • Une culture d'entreprise inégalable : c'est notre plus grande priorité et notre plus grande force;
  • Ambiance décontractée : on travaille pour vivre et non l'inverse;
  • Cinq semaines de vacances rémunérées;
  • Congés de maladie illimités;
  • Assurance collective et télémédecine;
  • Programme de REER collectif;
  • Compte mieux-être pour tes dépenses personnelles;
  • Activités sociales et deteam building;
  • Budget annuel de formation;
  • Horaire flexible : on travaille généralement de jour, mais l'horaire est adaptable et toutes les rencontres sont virtuelles. Où que tu sois, on te livre un laptop et te voilà prêt·e pour ta première journée !

En passant, notre processus de recrutement est simple et rapide :

  1. Entretien virtuel pour apprendre à se connaître;
  2. Entretien virtuel axé sur les compétences techniques;
  3. Test technique;
  4. Offre d'emploi.

Rendez-vous sur nos réseaux sociaux pour en voir plus :

  • Instagram
  • Facebook
  • LinkedIn

Le poste t'intéresse ? Soumets ta candidature et viens échanger avec nous !

Chez Thirdbridge, on croit à l'équité, à la diversité et à l'inclusion. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération pour un emploi, sans tenir compte de la race, de la couleur, de la religion, du sexe, de l'identité ou de l'expression sexuelle, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'origine nationale, de la génétique, du handicap, de l'âge ou du statut d'ancien combattant. Si tu as un handicap, n'hésite pas à nous dire comment nous pourrions adapter le processus d'entrevue pour mieux te convenir. Il nous fera plaisir de t'accommoder. Nous recevons un grand nombre de candidatures et afin de mieux gérer le processus, nous contacterons uniquement les personnes sélectionnées pour la suite. Si ton profil correspond à ce que nous recherchons, tu entendras bientôt parler de nous !

raw.description:
HOTEL DEVELOPMENT INTERN KSA

ABOUT KERTEN HOSPITALITY

Kerten Hospitality(KH) is an end-to-end lifestyle hospitality operator creating bespoke destinations, lodging, experiences and communities while optimising operations and driving profitability for savvy investors with a strong commitment to sustainability. KH transforms destinations through impactful partnerships with Lodging, Food & Beverage, Retail, Entertainment, Art and Wellness brands with a focus on building Ecosystems, and unique community-centric destinations, which connect International & local travellers. The Group’s current pipeline of lodging includes projects in numerous countries in the Middle East, Europe, and North Africa region. An expanding development pipeline of more than 55 lodging projects representing over 4,500 keys planned across our international development pipeline.

ABOUT REMOTESHIP

At Kerten Hospitality, we believe talent has no borders. Our Remoteship Program is a remote internship designed for ambitious individuals who want real hospitality exposure, not just observation, but true involvement. Through Remoteship, interns become part of live projects across our global portfolio. Whether it’s operations, marketing, People Services, development, or finance, you’ll work alongside our teams and contribute to meaningful initiatives that shape our brands and properties.

ABOUT THE ROLE

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Source and identify lodging development opportunities in Saudi by meeting different owners, developers, consulting firms, and more.

  • Analyze potential development opportunities across Saudi, including financial, operational, and strategic feasibility.

  • Map key stakeholders including developers, brokers, investors, and landlords.

  • Support financial feasibility analyses and preliminary site evaluations of the potential properties.

  • Identify strategic partners and high-value opportunities through data analysis and networking research.

  • Prepare reports, presentations, pitch decks, and internal briefing materials of the prospective lodging projects.

  • Support outreach, meeting coordination, and relationship management activities to secure new lodging opportunities.

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

  • Background and current education may be from a range of sectors including real estate, business, hospitality, or related industries.

  • Strong interest in Saudi's hospitality development and lifestyle real estate.

  • Exposure to real estate networks or connections is a plus.

  • Self-driven and highly independent, able to manage responsibilities and deliver results in a remote work environment.

  • Strong ownership mindset, takes initiative and sources potential lodging development opportunities within designated country.

  • Strong research, analytical, and presentation skills.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint required).

  • Based in Saudi and strong familiarity with the market.

JOINING OUR TEAM MEANS

  • Competitive Compensation: A rewarding package tailored to your experience.

  • Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement within our dynamic organisation.

  • Inclusive Environment: A vibrant and inclusive workplace that encourages collaboration.

  • Shared Purpose:Working with passionate people who live our values every day — connecting, innovating, curating, and leading the way together.

Please submit a cover letter via email , explaining how you can contribute to sourcing lodging development opportunities in Spain and what you aim to gain from the internship.

ApplyCRAFT YOUR CAREER. - Kerten Hospitality

Job Description

Position Overview

At TransPerfect, linguists are vital to our operations. Your language proficiency and subject matter expertise will ensure our deliverables meet the highest standards before reaching clients. Working closely with your manager and Project Managers, you will translate and proofread documents for a diverse client base in the Life Science industries.

This is a client-facing Language Lead position. In addition to linguistic work, the Language Lead is responsible for quality management and for coordinating a team of linguists.

This is a remote freelance position open to candidates worldwide.

We are currently expanding our pool of freelance linguists who can translate:

From English into Simplified Chinese (China) for:

  • CTD Quality

  • CTD Non-Clinical

  • CTD Clinical

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Quality Management

  • Act as a client-facing linguistic point of contact, representing TransPerfect with professionalism.

  • Review and investigate client complaints and quality-related issues, determine root causes, and provide timely, well-documented responses and corrective actions.

  • Maintain language quality standards across projects and accounts.

  • Manage language assets, including translation memories (TMs), glossaries, and style guides, ensuring they are accurate, consistent, and up to date.

raw.description:
Senior Technical Writer

Position Summary

The Senior Technical Writer supports projects that produce requirements documentation, solution design documentation, and operating model documentation for technical programs. This role is responsible for translating complex technical decisions — including architecture and system diagrams — into clear, well-organized, and accurate documentation.

The Senior Technical Writer works as part of a team to draft, format, and assemble documentation deliverables, maintain version control of documentation, and ensure consistency and quality across artifacts. This role goes beyond editing or transcription: the Senior Technical Writer must be able to read and understand architecture and technical diagrams well enough to update existing diagrams and produce new ones using standard diagramming conventions.

Success in this role requires strong technical acumen, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to work closely with technical stakeholders to accurately capture and document decisions. This position requires demonstrated technical writing ability and the capacity to understand and document technical concepts, diagrams, and architecture. Candidates will be asked to submit a writing sample and a diagram-based work sample as part of the application process.

Key Functions

  • Collaborate with Solution Architects, DevSecOps Engineers, Cybersecurity teams, and Database Administrators to understand complex technical solutions for Salesforce and AWS development, test, and other environments in the CI/CD pipeline.
  • Produce and maintain requirements documentation supporting solution design and technical decision-making.
  • Draft and assemble solution design documentation, including narrative content, diagrams, and supporting artifacts.
  • Produce and maintain operating model documentation.
  • Create, update, and revise architecture and technical diagrams, applying standard shapes, connectors, and diagramming conventions consistently.
  • Translate technical decisions and discussions into clear, well-organized documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Format, assemble, and finalize documentation deliverables for internal and client review.
  • Maintain version control of documentation in Confluence or an equivalent content management platform.
  • Ensure documentation deliverables meet Section 508 accessibility compliance standards.
  • Collaborate with technical stakeholders to accurately capture architecture, requirements, and design decisions.
  • Support consistency and quality across documentation deliverables, including formatting standards and terminology.
  • Participate in technical discovery and design sessions to gather source material for documentation.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with federal clients, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders while supporting mission-critical systems.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, and 3 years of relevant experience.
  • Associate's Degree and 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree.
  • High School Diploma and 7 years of relevant experience in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree.
  • Required: submission of a writing sample demonstrating the ability to translate technical material into clear, well-organized documentation.
  • Required: submission of a diagram-based work sample (e.g., interpreting or reproducing a sample architecture/technical diagram using standard shapes and connectors) demonstrating the ability to read and produce technical diagrams.
  • Demonstrated ability to read, interpret, and reproduce architecture and technical diagrams using standard shapes, connectors, and diagramming conventions (e.g., in Visio, Lucidchart, or similar tools).
  • Sufficient technical acumen to understand software, infrastructure, or systems concepts well enough to document them accurately — this is not a purely administrative or transcription-focused role.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with strong attention to detail, grammar, and formatting consistency.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple documentation deliverables concurrently.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with technical stakeholders to accurately capture and document decisions.
  • Ability to shift focus between competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or similar diagramming tools using standard architecture notation.
  • Experience with Confluence, Jira, or similar documentation and collaboration platforms.
  • Experience writing for Federal government clients.
  • Coursework, certification, or prior experience in technical writing, information design, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting federal government programs or documentation deliverables.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Experience formatting documentation for Section 508 accessibility compliance.

Position Details

  • Employment type: Full-Time, W2
  • Location: 100% Remote (US-based)
  • Hours: 40 hours/week with availability during core business hours of 8am–5pm ET
  • Start date: On or around October 1, 2026
  • Eligibility: Must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust clearance
  • Salary: $60,200–$80,200 annually, commensurate with experience

Equal Opportunity Statement

PhoenixTeam is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Salary: $60,000 - $80,000

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a System Administrator Specialist to support the National Institutes of Health (NIH), National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) under the Business Process and Information Management Branch (BPIMB) ServiceNow Support Services (SNSS) program.

In this role, you will perform daily system configuration and operational activities that support NIAID's ServiceNow environment and related platforms. You will optimize system performance, monitor resource utilization, assist users in accessing and using business systems, and support the stability, security, and efficiency of technical operations across ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, SecOps, VR, and integrated systems.

This position requires hands-on operational support skills, familiarity with enterprise platforms, and experience delivering reliable system administration services in a large, complex environment.

Other responsibilities will include:

  • Maintain documentation for system procedures, configurations, operational tasks, change records, and runbooks.

  • Perform log reviews, error analysis, and basic root cause analysis for operational incidents.

  • Support backup, restore, and disaster recovery testing as part of continuity-of-operations requirements.

  • Participate in formal and informal review checkpoints throughout the development and release lifecycle.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain NIH Public Trust.

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience).

  • 3 or more years of experience performing system administration in a large computer-based environment.

  • Hands-on experience administering or supporting ServiceNow, including configuration, operational maintenance, user management, workflows, or integrations.

  • Basic scripting skills, including JavaScript or equivalent scripting ability used within ServiceNow or similar enterprise platforms.

  • Experience performing daily system operations, configuration updates, maintenance, patching, and monitoring.

  • Ability to analyze system performance, resource utilization, and capacity trends.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, communication skills, and customer support competency.

Desired Skills:

  • Experience supporting ServiceNow ITOM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, or Integration Hub.

Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare? Are you excited to shape the operating model that enables the R&D organisation to scale? Sound like you? Keep reading.

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:

Impact - We do work that matters.

Collaboration - We are in it together.

Human touch - We care deeply.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and France (with occasional travel to our London or Paris offices) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What you will be doing

We're looking for a Product Operations Manager to build the operational backbone of our product organisation. Reporting to the Head of Product, you'll own the systems and cadences that keep Product, Engineering, Design, and Go-to-market aligned, and build the AI-powered workflows and automations that let a lean team move like a much bigger one.
- Establish the operating cadence. Build and run the rhythms that keep the product org aligned and moving fast, along with the processes and tools that enable quicker, better-informed decisions. - Ensure OKRs are tracked and effectively measure impact and outcomes.
- Transform data into actionable insights. Build and maintain frameworks for capturing, organising, and centralising user feedback, including early access and beta releases. Partner with Data Analytics to build dashboards on product and customer health, and synthesise feedback, usage data, and support trends into clear opportunities that inform roadmap prioritisation.
- Own release operations, enabling teams and AI agents to continuously ship value to customers while meeting compliance, security, and regulatory standards.
- Close operational gaps at scale. Identify bottlenecks across the product development lifecycle and lead initiatives to simplify, standardise, or automate them. Build checklists, playbooks, and self-serve resources that support product teams from ideation through post-launch and establish repeatable ways to measure and iterate on efficiency gains.
- Champion AI adoption. Stay current on emerging AI tools and agent capabilities; design, pilot, and roll out AI-powered workflows and automations that measurably improve how the product team works.

What we are looking for

You’ll join a highly collaborative Product team, working closely with R&D as well as our Applied AI team. This is a hands-on, builder's role in which you’ll treat our operating model as an internal product and be accountable for its impact.

- Experience building, scaling, or meaningfully shaping a Product Operations framework, not just operating within one already in place, that increased the team impact.

Who We Are

CXAPP is a forward-thinking technology company that leverages AI and data science to drive innovation and deliver cutting-edge solutions. At CXApp, we are the innovators of Indoor Intelligence, delivering actionable insights for people, places and things. Our flagship product “CXAI” (formerly CXApp) is a workplace experience platform for the enterprise. Our technologies and solutions help enterprise customers deliver a comprehensive business journey in a work ‘from-anywhere’ world for employees, partners, customers, and visitors.

We take pride in the way we positively impact the daily lives of our customers and continue to push the boundaries of how our platform can benefit others.

The technology:

The CXApp platform tech stack uses native mapping, analytics, on-device positioning and app technologies. The overall solution helps organizations provide a frictionless work environment to employees with features such as: hot desk and room booking, indoor navigation with turn-by-turn directions on a digital map, company-wide news feeds, an in-app company directory of colleagues and workplace amenities, as well as bookable opportunities and experiences.

Job Description:

Are you passionate about helping customers succeed and thrive? Do you have a proven track record of driving adoption, expansion, and renewals in a SaaS or technology environment? If so, we want you to join our team as a Customer Success Manager.

Role Overview: As a Customer Success Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our customers' satisfaction, success, and continued partnership with CXApp. You will be responsible for driving product adoption, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring high renewal rates among our customer base. Your focus will be on building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and delivering exceptional value. This CSM role is a remote position in the Los Angeles, California area.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Customer Onboarding: Guide new customers through the onboarding process, ensuring they have a smooth and successful start with our products or services.
  2. Adoption and Engagement: Monitor customer usage and engagement with our products, proactively identifying opportunities to drive increased adoption and value.
  3. Relationship Building: Build and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within customer organizations, becoming a trusted advisor and advocate for their success.
  4. Product Knowledge: Develop a deep understanding of our products or services and their applications within each customer's unique context.
  5. Account Planning: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, and support, to develop and execute account plans that drive customer success and growth.
  6. Expansion Opportunities: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional products or services to existing customers, working closely with the sales team to maximize revenue.
  7. Renewal Management: Ensure a high percentage of customer renewals by proactively addressing any potential issues or concerns and demonstrating the ongoing value of our solutions.
  8. Customer Feedback: Collect and relay customer feedback to internal teams, advocating for product improvements and enhancements based on customer needs.
  9. Customer Advocacy: Encourage and support satisfied customers to become advocates, sharing their success stories and referrals.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field (MBA a plus).
  • Proven experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or similar role in a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong understanding of customer success principles and best practices.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and project management skills.
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Familiarity with CRM software and customer success tools (e.g., HubSpot) is a plus.

If you feel you have the qualifications we are looking for and CXApp sounds like something you want to be part of, apply now. We can't promise it will be a fit, but we do promise to consider your experience.

At CXApp, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

job summary

We are seeking an Instructional Designer to design, develop, and maintain the training curriculum and knowledge resources for two core audiences: TM App Teachers worldwide, and TM Teachers and national offices that have adopted MFI's integrated business tools (the TM Suite). You will build and maintain training courses, help centers, and training materials for both audiences, keeping them current and effective as MFI's digital products evolve.

You will also support national offices through onboarding — helping stakeholders stay aligned and self-sufficient as they adopt MFI's tools.

This position requires strong organisation, planning, and verbal/written communication skills.

about you

Please only apply for this role if you are a certified Transcendental Meditation teacher.

You are driven to help others by sharing knowledge clearly. You enjoy taking complex or technical information and turning it into training that's simple and engaging to follow. You're comfortable with detailed technical concepts and enjoy building structure and organisational systems around them.

You are naturally proactive, able to manage multiple workstreams and prioritise well. You communicate clearly with different audiences — teachers, national stakeholders, and internal teams alike — and enjoy building relationships with a multicultural group of stakeholders.

responsibilities

Training & Curriculum

  • Design, build, and maintain training courses that prepare TM teachers to use MFI's digital products

  • Write presentation scripts and produce/record training videos

  • Build training for new tools and systems as they roll out to teachers and national offices

  • Manage enrollment and provide ongoing training support to trainees

Knowledge Base & Ongoing Readiness

  • Own and maintain help center content for both audiences

  • Keep all training materials and knowledge resources current as features ship — update content proactively alongside product releases

Stakeholder Support & Alignment

  • Support national offices adopting MFI tools during migration and rollout projects, helping teams build the confidence and knowledge to support their own teachers

  • Build relationships and trust with a multicultural group of national stakeholders

  • Coordinate with other teams to keep training and communications aligned with project timelines

  • Surface stakeholder training needs and questions to the wider team

Communications

  • Own teacher communications for the app-teacher audience, including updates when new features go live

  • Build and implement communication campaigns, including writing and editing emails

  • Tailor communication to different internal and external stakeholder groups

skills and requirements

  • Certified Transcendental Meditation Teacher with 5 years' experience

  • Bonus points if you've already been trained in how to use the TM App to teach TM with the digital course

  • Experience creating curricula and training content, both live and recorded

  • Experience managing or maintaining a knowledge base or help center (Intercom or similar)

  • Comfortable with detailed technical understanding of digital products/platforms

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience documenting processes and keeping materials up to date over time

  • Experience working with stakeholders across teams or organisations

  • Experience working in a global non-profit, remote team, or multinational organization preferred

  • Fluency in English (written and verbal)

If you are passionate about this work but do not have all of the skills listed we are still interested in speaking with you and encourage you to apply!

pay and benefits

Our pay levels are set according to a formula that combines above-median market rate data for the role (we pay 55th percentile of New York market rate for this role, based on Payscale data) adjusted for your local cost of living based on Numbeo data.

We take the issue of equitable pay very seriously, and we apply our pay formula to all workers who work 80% or more of full-time hours with us.

diversity and inclusion

We care about diversity - we strive to ensure all of our team feel included and can bring their whole selves to work but we also know that this work is never 'done' or complete, and that we can always improve.

Our team is fully remote, living and working across 20 countries across the world, and we'd love to hear how you can add to our special culture at MFI.

raw.excerpt: CTS seeks a Cost Analyst Subject Matter Expert to provide technical expertise to the Evaluations, Assessments, Studies, Services, and Support (EASSS) contract.
raw.description:
CTS seeks a Cost Analyst Subject Matter Expert to provide technical expertise to the Evaluations, Assessments, Studies, Services, and Support (EASSS) contract. This contract supports NASA Headquarters Science Mission Directorate (SMD) and facilitates NASA’s pursuit of the most noteworthy approaches for missions, payloads, spacecraft, instruments, and research that help answer the big questions in Earth and Space science. Located at LaRC, the NASA’s Science Office for Mission Assessments (SOMA) helps SMD select and manage missions, spacecraft, and instruments. To accomplish this, SOMA manages and provides oversight of evaluations, assessments, and studies for SMD and other NASA organizations. These include evaluation of proposals received in response to NASA Announcements of Opportunity, NASA Research Announcements, Cooperative Agreement Notices, and Broad Agency Announcements, as well as highly specialized studies and assessments, such as life cycle and independent cost estimates, schedule assessments, and risk analyses. CTS supports SOMA via the EASSS contract by providing subject matter experts who will apply their expertise to complex proposal evaluations, management and technical assessments, and advanced studies through the EASSS contract.

CTS’s subject matter experts need not be local to the program office near NASA Langley Research Center in Hampton, VA. We seek individuals who bring significant Technical, Management and Cost expertise in missions, payloads, spacecraft and instruments relevant to NASA’s mission. The work is performed remotely with less than 10% travel occurring periodically for some during the assignment to bring the geographically distributed teams together for workshops to finalize results.

The Cost Analyst must have at least five (5) years of experience in estimating and analyzing space mission cost utilizing parametric models. Must be proficient in the use of aerospace industry standard cost analysis tools. Many cost estimating models exist, as is the case with the estimating methodologies, no single cost model can be used for all purposes. Estimating models can vary significantly in terms of data availability and automation. The knowledge of some of the following tools is greatly desired:

  • SEER (especially SEER-H)

  • Trueplanning
  • Project Cost Estimating Capability (PCEC)

  • NASA Air Force Cost Model (NAFCOM)

  • NASA Instrument Cost Model (NICM)

  • Technology Cost & Schedule Estimation (TCASE)

  • Schedule Management & Relationship Tool (SMART)

  • Phasing Model

  • One NASA Cost Engineering (ONCE) database

  • REDSTAR database

  • Polaris

  • Argo

  • Automated Cost Estimating Integrated Tools (ACEIT)

  • CO$TAT

  • Joint Analysis of Cost and Schedule (JACS)

    • PRICE cost models

Education: Must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Finance, Engineering, or other directly related field.

We thank you for your time and consideration of our current opening. If you choose to apply please be sure to upload your most recent and detailed resume for our review.

CTS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate in our hiring or employment practices regardless of employment type.

raw.title: Full Stack Developer
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a US based Full Stack Developer to help design, build, and scale our SaaS platform.
raw.description:
We are looking for a US based Full Stack Developer
to help design, build, and scale our SaaS platform. You will work across the stack, from responsive front end interfaces to backend services, APIs, and data layers, collaborating closely with product, design, and other engineers to ship reliable, high-performance features used by our customers. This is a great role for someone who enjoys owning features end to end, reasoning about system design tradeoffs, and growing their skills across the entire technology stack.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain features across the full stack, from responsive UI components to backend services, APIs, and database schemas
  • Own features end to end, from technical design and estimation through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
  • Design and implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, versioning, and query performance
  • Write efficient database queries and design normalized schemas; contribute to indexing and query optimization for relational and/or NoSQL data stores
  • Build and maintain integrations with third party systems and APIs, including authentication flows (OAuth2/SSO) and webhook-based event handling
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; maintain strong automated test coverage and participate in thorough code reviews
  • Contribute to system architecture decisions, including service boundaries, caching strategy, and data flow, as the platform scales
  • Improve application performance through profiling, load testing, and query/caching optimization
  • Instrument and monitor services using logging, metrics, and tracing tools; troubleshoot and resolve production incidents
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, infrastructure as code, and deployment automation
  • Apply secure coding practices (input validation, encryption in transit/at rest, dependency and vulnerability management)
  • Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retros

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional full stack development experience
  • Strong proficiency in a modern front end framework (Angular) and TypeScript/JavaScript, including component architecture and state management
  • Strong backend experience in Spring Framework building production services
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs; familiarity with API versioning and documentation
  • Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) including schema design and query optimization, and/or NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, including core compute, storage, and networking services
  • Proficiency with Git, code review workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI)
  • Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) using frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, Cypress, or Playwright
  • Strong understanding of web application security best practices (OWASP Top 10, authentication/authorization, encryption)
  • Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross functionally

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GraphQL schema design and resolvers
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Experience with microservices, event-driven architectures, and message queues/streaming (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)
  • Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry)
  • Familiarity with e-signature or document workflow tools and their APIs
  • Contributions to open-source projects

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible PTO and remote friendly culture
  • Learning and development budget
  • Collaborative, high growth environment

raw.description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

raw.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
raw.excerpt: Who We Are:Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.

This role is open to REMOTE work.

Job Mission

As a member of the Information Security Team, the Senior Vulnerability Management & SOAR Engineer will lead and mature the organization's enterprise Vulnerability Management Program, protecting applications, infrastructure, cloud services, endpoints, containers, and technology platforms from current and emerging threats. This role serves as the primary technical authority for vulnerability discovery, validation, prioritization, remediation coordination, exception management, and security automation.
The position partners closely with Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, DevOps, Architecture, Security Operations, and Technology teams to continuously reduce cyber risk through effective vulnerability lifecycle management and operational excellence. Drive accountability across technical teams, improve vulnerability remediation processes, and leverage automation and SOAR technologies to scale program effectiveness, reporting, and risk reduction efforts.
This individual contributor role requires both deep technical expertise and strong program ownership, balancing hands-on vulnerability operations with strategic leadership to continuously strengthen the organization's security posture.
Role Allocation: 90% Vulnerability Management | 10 % SOAR Engineering & Security
Note: Off-hour support and travel may be required.
Major Accountabilities
Vulnerability Management & Risk Reduction
• Own and continuously mature the enterprise Vulnerability Management Program across on-premises, cloud, containerized, endpoint, network, embedded, and application environments.
• Manage the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle, including discovery, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking, exception management, verification, and reporting.
• Operate and optimize vulnerability assessment technologies to ensure comprehensive asset coverage and accurate risk visibility.
• Correlate and prioritize findings from vulnerability scanners, application security tools, cloud and container security platforms, attack surface management solutions, and threat intelligence sources.
• Apply risk-based methodologies leveraging CVSS, CISA KEV, exploitability, asset criticality, exposure, and business impact to identify and prioritize the most significant threats.
• Integrate vulnerability management processes with CI/CD pipelines and software delivery workflows to identify and address security weaknesses earlier in the development lifecycle.
• Partner with asset management teams to improve asset inventory accuracy, security coverage, and risk visibility across the enterprise.
Remediation Leadership & Governance
• Coordinate and drive remediation efforts across technical teams to ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within established service-level objectives and/or sensitivity.
• Lead response activities for critical vulnerabilities, zero-day threats, and actively exploited CVEs
• Manage vulnerability exceptions, compensating controls, risk acceptance processes, and periodic exception reviews.
• Develop and maintain vulnerability management policies, standards, procedures, runbooks, and reporting frameworks.
• Create executive and operational metrics measuring risk reduction, remediation, performance, vulnerability trends, asset coverage, SLA adherence, and MTTR.
• Support audits, compliance assessments, and risk management activities through accurate documentation and evidence collection.
• Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and industry best practices to continuously improve program effectiveness.
SOAR Engineering & Security Automation (10%)
• Design, develop, and maintain SOAR playbooks that automate vulnerability intake, triage, enrichment, ticket creation, remediation tracking, exception handling, and reporting.
• Develop integrations between vulnerability management platforms, SOAR, SIEM, ITSM, CMDB, DevOps, and collaboration platforms.
• Build scripts, APIs, and automated workflows using technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, and REST APIs to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
• Measure automation effectiveness and recommend technology enhancements that strengthen vulnerability management and security operations capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Vulnerability Management, Security Operations, Security Engineering, Cybersecurity Risk Management, or related security disciplines.
    • 3+ years of directly managing or owning enterprise vulnerability management programs in hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
    • Experience administering enterprise vulnerability management platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, or equivalent solutions.
    • Strong expertise in vulnerability assessment, credentialed scanning, vulnerability validation, risk prioritization, and remediation management.
    • Deep understanding of CVE, CVSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, threat intelligence, attack surface management, and risk scoring methodologies.
    • Experience with cloud platforms and cloud security technologies including Azure, AWS, or GCP.
    • Experience managing vulnerabilities across cloud-native, containerized, and modern application environments.
    • Scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, REST APIs, or similar technologies.
    • Experience building security automations using Microsoft Sentinel, Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Swimlane, Tines, or similar platforms.
    • Familiarity with application security concepts
    • Experience developing metrics, KPIs, dashboards, remediation SLAs, and executive reporting for vulnerability management programs.
    • Strong understanding of operating systems, network infrastructure, software development processes, and enterprise technology environments.
    • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, CMMC, or similar regulatory requirements is preferred.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.
    • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CySA+, Security+, GSEC, GCSA, OSCP, GIAC certifications, or equivalent experience are preferred.
Boston, MA Headquarters - (NB) Only Pay Range: $104,500.00 - $130,000.00 - $155,500.00 Annual (actual base pay varying based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience, time in role, internal equity, geographic location, and more.)


Regular Associate Benefits

Our products are only as good as the people we hire, so we make sure to hire the best and treat them accordingly. New Balance offers a comprehensive traditional benefits package including three options for medical insurance as well as dental, vision, life insurance and 401K. We also proudly offer a slate of more nontraditional perks – opportunities like online learning and development courses, tuition reimbursement, $100 monthly student loan support and various mentorship programs – that encourage our associates to grow personally as they develop professionally. You’ll also enjoy a yearly $1,000 lifestyle reimbursement, 4 weeks of vacations, 12 holidays and generous parental leave, because work-life balance is more than just a buzzword – it’s part of our culture.

Temporary associates are provided three options for medical insurance as well as dental and vision insurance and an associate discount.

Part time associates are provided 401k, short term disability, a yearly $300 lifestyle reimbursement and an associate discount.

Flexible Work Schedule

For decades we have fostered a unique culture founded on our values with a particular focus on in-person teamwork and collaboration. Our North American hybrid model encourages rich in-person experiences, showcasing our commitment to teamwork and connection, while maintaining flexibility for associates. New Balance Associates currently work in office three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Our offices are fully open, and amenities are available across our North American office locations. To continue our focus on hybrid work we have introduced “Work from Anywhere” (WFA) for four weeks per calendar year. This model will help us enhance our culture while continuing to maintain elements of flexibility.

Equal Opportunity Employer

New Balance provides equal opportunities for all current and prospective associates to ensure that employment, training, compensation, transfer, promotion and other terms, conditions and privileges of employment are provided without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, handicap, genetic information and/or status as an Armed Forces service medal veteran, recently separated veteran, qualified disabled veteran or other protected veteran, or any other protected status.

raw.description:
About the Role
Hotels and tourism businesses across Finland have room to grow, and you'll help them find it. As Account Executive, you'll build VISIT's new business in the Finnish market, guiding decision-makers from the first conversation to a signed deal. You'll report to the Commercial Director and work side by side with our Solution Experts and the wider commercial team, as a key early hire in building VISIT's Finnish organisation.

What You Will Do

  • Build and own a healthy pipeline of new business with hotels and tourism businesses in Finland

  • Drive sales processes from first contact through needs analysis, presentation and negotiation to close.

  • Lead consultative conversations with decision-makers, understanding their business before shaping the right solution.

  • Collaborate with Solution Experts, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Product to create solutions that bring real value to our customers.

  • Represent VISIT at industry events, trade fairs and workshops, and develop strategic partnerships in the Finnish market.

  • Share market insights that help shape our commercial strategy and offering.

Keep your sales work well documented and stay close to developments in the hotel and tourism industry

Who You Are

  • You win new business. You have at least 3 to 5 years of B2B sales experience where you have found, built and closed your own deals. This is not a junior role

  • You might come to us from hospitality or travel technology sales such as PMS, booking engines, channel management or payments; B2B SaaS or tech sales with a proven record of hitting new-business targets; or hotel or tourism sales, ready to bring that customer understanding to the vendor side

  • You have owned the full sales cycle: creating opportunities, prioritizing your pipeline and driving deals to close

  • You're curious about how hotels and tourism businesses make money: occupancy, rates, direct bookings and distribution. Industry experience gives you a head start, and if you don't have it yet, we'll help you build it quickly

  • You build trust, ask good questions and understand a customer's business before presenting a solution

  • You're proactive, entrepreneurial and comfortable building something over time. You're driven by winning new business, value long-term customer relationships and are easy to collaborate with

  • A background in hotel operations, revenue management or distribution, hands-on experience with hospitality technology, an established network in the Finnish hotel and tourism industry, or Swedish is a plus

  • Fluency in English and Finnish is required for this role

Why VISIT?
At VISIT, we believe in experiences that move us and change us, and in the people who help create them. We only grow when our customers do, so we work side by side, with them and with each other.

What you can expect:

  • A team that shares knowledge, solves challenges side by side and celebrates success together

  • Real ownership, and colleagues who stand by what they promise

  • An industry that never stands still, with room to learn, adapt and evolve with it

  • An international environment with colleagues across more than 10 countries

Location & Ways of Working
This role is remote, and you'll be based in Finland. Most meetings are held remotely, and you'll meet customers on site when needed. Occasional trips to our Gothenburg office and to internal events (QBR, Sales Kickoff, VISIT Summit) come with the role, roughly 3 to 5 times a year.

Interested?
We'd love to hear from you. Apply now, and let's grow together.

About VISIT
VISIT is a platform that brings together everything hospitality, experience, and short-term rentals need to be efficient, profitable and make connections that deliver captivating guest experiences.

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, VISIT has grown into a team of 400+ employees across more than 10 countries.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Operations Support Coordinator

Compensation range: $1,200 AUD - $1,500 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is a growing Australian hospitality and restaurant group with a network of venues operating across multiple locations, supported by a central corporate team.

The business has built its reputation around delivering a distinctive dining experience, combining quality food, strong service, and a lively venue environment. With a large and diverse workforce across corporate and franchised locations, the business places a strong emphasis on people, operational standards, compliance, and creating a positive employee experience.

Role Overview: The Operations Support Coordinator is the first point of contact for franchise and corporate site requests. The role manages the Operations support desk and makes sure every request is acknowledged, prioritised and resolved within agreed response times.

It also provides executive support to the Head of Operations and administrative support to the Operations team. You’ll work directly to the Head of Operations and closely with Franchise Partners, Venue Leaders and Support Office departments.

Key Responsibilities:

Franchise Partner Support Desk

  • Manage the Operations support desk inbox and ticketing system as the single point of entry for all site enquiries.
  • Triage every request by category and priority, resolving straightforward requests directly using the FAQ / Knowledge Sheet or published policy.
  • Apply previous decisions from the Precedent Log to repeat requests, and escalate new or complex requests to the Head of Operations.
  • Route requests to the correct Support Office Help Desk (IT, Supply Chain, Finance, People & Culture, Retail, Development, Facilities) and track them through to resolution.
  • Track performance against agreed target response times, and prepare response time reporting for Quarterly Business Reviews.
  • Maintain the Precedent Log, review request trends monthly and draft FAQ updates for approval.
  • Produce a monthly report on repeat requests and emerging issues across the network.
  • Track audit schedules and results, and follow up outstanding actions with sites.

Executive and Team Support

  • Provide administrative support to the Head of Operations.
  • Prepare meeting packs, agendas, minutes and follow-up actions.
  • Prepare presentations and documents to brand standards (PowerPoint, Excel and Word).
  • Maintain operational calendars, action registers and project timelines.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in operations coordination, project coordination or business administration.
  • Experience with a ticketing or help desk system (FreshDesk, Zendesk or similar) is highly regarded.
  • Hospitality, retail, franchise, or multi-site experience is highly regarded.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong written English for clear, professional communication with venue owners and leaders.
  • Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Sound judgement on when to resolve, when to route, and when to escalate.
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders across geographically dispersed locations.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills.
  • Highly organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.description:
R3 Lithium operates North America's first commercial-scale lithium carbonate recovery facility, located in Covington, Georgia. Using a lithium-first extraction process, the company recovers, refines, and returns lithium carbonate from recycled black mass into the battery supply chain for energy storage systems, defense applications, and electric vehicles. Founded in 2026 and privately held, R3 Lithium is headquartered at 9176 Industrial Drive NE, Covington, Georgia. For more information, visit

Position Overview:

The Vice President of Engineering is responsible for key value creation activities in the company. The candidate will have an opportunity to make a significant contribution to the future success of the company by providing outstanding managerial and technical leadership.

As the Vice President of Engineering, you will play a critical role in leading our engineering efforts, overseeing the design, development, and construction of our plants. You will ensure that our engineered materials meet the highest standards of quality and performance while driving strategic initiatives to facilitate our capacity expansion in North America. This role requires a leader with experience in materials and/or chemical engineering, has worked closely with R&D, with project management, with production management, and is a great cross-functional collaborator. This position will report directly to the CEO.

Key Responsibilities:

  • The Engineering VP will plan and direct all aspects of engineering activities and projects within the organization. The job entails establishing new policies and procedures, as well as ensuring all engineering projects, initiatives, and processes are in conformity with the organization and industry established policies and objectives.
  • The Engineering VP will utilize best practice engineering methods to provide expert technical guidance for engineering initiatives. The Engineering VP will incorporate all functions related to testing, repair, and maintenance of all equipment to be used in the organization.
  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the company’s goals, particularly focusing on production plant construction.
  • Project Management: Oversee all engineering projects, ensuring timely completion, adherence to budgets, and alignment with quality standards. Implement best practices in project management and engineering processes.
  • Team Development: Build and lead a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement. Mentor engineers and provide professional development opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including R&D, operations, and supply chain, to ensure alignment on project objectives and resource allocation.
  • Technical Oversight: Provide technical guidance in the development of engineered materials, ensuring they meet customer specifications and regulatory requirements. Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in battery materials. Develop appropriate engineering standards, the company’s bill of process and bill of design.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all engineering activities comply with relevant safety, environmental, and industry regulations, particularly as we expand internationally.
  • Budget Management: Develop and manage the engineering budget, identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality and performance.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including executive leadership, investors, and regulatory bodies, to represent the engineering perspective and ensure alignment with corporate objectives.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or professional engineering, a plus.
  • 20+ years of experience in engineering management, with a focus on battery materials or related industries a plus.
  • Big company and small company experience, a plus.
  • Experience translating science level R&D ideas to engineering design packages.
  • Proven track record of leading large-scale engineering projects, particularly in the construction of manufacturing facilities or mega plants.
  • Strong knowledge of materials development and testing processes, particularly in the context of battery technologies.
  • New product introduction experience, a plus
  • Product certification experience, a plus
  • Experience in international expansion and understanding of European market dynamics is a plus.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

What We Offer :

  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Participation in the Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).
  • Opportunity to lead the engineering activities of a high growth company in a new high growth industry.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment dedicated to sustainability.

Senior Solutions Architect – Cybersecurity (Remote – California)

Full-Time, Part-Time, or Contract | Competitive Compensation + Performance Incentives

About GigaKOM

For more than 20 years, GigaKOM has delivered enterprise-level IT solutions to California K–12 school districts, higher education institutions, state and local government agencies, and commercial organizations. Through partnerships with leading manufacturers and technology providers—including Cisco, HPE Aruba, and top cybersecurity vendors—we design and deliver secure, scalable solutions that protect mission-critical environments.

As cybersecurity continues to be a top priority for our clients, GigaKOM is expanding its security practice and seeking a Senior Solutions Architect – Cybersecurity to lead the design and evolution of advanced security architectures across enterprise and cloud environments.

Location

Remote – California

This is a fully remote position supporting client environments across California.

Position Overview

The Senior Solutions Architect – Cybersecurity is a strategic, client-facing leadership role responsible for designing, guiding, and advancing cybersecurity architectures across network, cloud, identity, endpoint, and SIEM/XDR environments.

This role serves as a technical authority and trusted advisor, working closely with executive stakeholders, sales teams, and engineering resources to define security strategy, architect solutions, and guide long-term modernization initiatives.

In addition to architecture, this position provides technical oversight, escalation support, and advisory guidance—ensuring security solutions are aligned with best practices, compliance frameworks, and evolving threat landscapes.

This is a high-impact role with the opportunity to influence GigaKOM’s cybersecurity portfolio, standards, and go-to-market strategy.

What You’ll Do

Lead Cybersecurity Architecture & Strategy

  • Design and lead implementation of enterprise security architectures across network, cloud, identity, endpoint, and data layers
  • Define and promote Zero Trust security frameworks and best practices
  • Establish reusable architectures and security standards across client environments
  • Guide long-term security roadmaps aligned with business and compliance objectives

Pre-Sales Leadership & Client Advisory

  • Partner with sales leadership on strategic opportunities and solution positioning
  • Lead client discovery sessions focused on risk, compliance, and architecture design
  • Present security strategies to CIOs, CISOs, and executive stakeholders
  • Drive technical leadership in proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and competitive positioning

Typical Engagements & Projects

  • Zero Trust architecture for K–12 and public sector organizations
  • Microsoft security ecosystem deployments (Microsoft Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel)
  • Endpoint security and XDR deployments (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, others)
  • SIEM/SOC architecture and optimization (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar)
  • Network security modernization (firewalls, segmentation, secure access)
  • Identity transformation (SSO, MFA, conditional access)
  • Compliance-driven security frameworks (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001)

Identity, Cloud & Data Security Architecture

  • Design identity-first security using Microsoft Entra ID (SSO, MFA, Conditional Access)
  • Architect secure Azure-based environments with integrated security controls
  • Define governance, access policies, and identity lifecycle management
  • Secure workloads, applications, and data across hybrid environments

Security Oversight & Threat Strategy

  • Provide escalation-level guidance for complex security incidents
  • Guide SIEM strategy, detection engineering, and advanced threat analysis
  • Architect and optimize SIEM and XDR platforms including Sentinel and CrowdStrike
  • Oversee vulnerability management and remediation strategies

Network & Infrastructure Security Design

  • Architect and validate solutions across Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, and similar platforms
  • Design segmentation, secure access, and perimeter defense strategies
  • Integrate network security with identity and cloud controls

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Lead alignment with frameworks such as NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, GDPR
  • Conduct risk assessments and define mitigation strategies
  • Support audit readiness and compliance initiatives
  • Advise on governance and security policy development

Collaboration & Practice Development

  • Mentor engineering teams and contribute to technical growth
  • Influence cybersecurity offerings and vendor alignment
  • Establish best practices, reference architectures, and reusable frameworks
  • Support cross-functional collaboration across sales, engineering, and leadership

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, architecture, or consulting
  • Proven experience designing enterprise-scale cybersecurity architectures
  • Strong expertise across network, cloud, identity, endpoint, and SIEM/XDR domains
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Microsoft Sentinel
