G’day, we’re Mosh & Moshy.

We’re a digital health platform on a mission to improve access to evidence-based care across Australia. Through discreet, telehealth-first programs spanning hair loss, sexual health, skincare, mental health and weight management, we support thousands of patients navigating their health journey in a modern way.

More than a job

There’s nothing better than the feeling that what you’re doing matters and makes a difference. We’re pretty lucky this is the norm and not the exception for us. In this role, you will provide high quality, evidence based care to improve patients’ access to a variety of healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity

As our patient community and health programs continue to grow, we’re looking for Australian-registered doctors currently practising in Australia to join our multidisciplinary clinical team on a flexible contractor basis.

This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful patient care through an established digital health platform, supported by strong clinical governance, clear treatment pathways and experienced operational and clinical teams.

Working remotely, you’ll consult with new and existing patients, assess their clinical needs and support them throughout their treatment journey. Depending on your experience, interests and our patient needs, you may work across one or more of our healthcare programs.

Responsibilities include:

  • Calling/video conferencing with new and existing patients to provide education, advice and assistance
  • Managing existing patient’s treatment plans, including assessing their response to current treatment and prescribing appropriate medications and making changes as appropriate and within scope of practice
  • Triaging presenting symptoms to the relevant medical practitioner/pharmacist
  • Liaising with managers, medical practitioners, pharmacists, allied health professionals and other employees
  • Sharing feedback for constant improvement of systems and processes to improve patient experience

You’ll retain responsibility for your own clinical decision-making while working within an established governance framework designed to support safe, consistent and high-quality care.

What you’ll bring

  • AHPRA General Registration as a PGY 5 + doctor
  • 2 years of clinical work experience in Australia
  • Must be based in Australia

Working with Mosh & Moshy

This role is offered as a flexible contractor engagement.

  • Fully remote telehealth delivery
  • Flexible session structure aligned to patient demand
  • Established patient base and operational infrastructure
  • Structured clinical governance and peer support
  • Opportunity to help shape the future of healthcare
  • Opportunities to advance your career as the business grows

What’s on offer

We hire teammates that share our values, believe in our mission and are passionate about the future of Aussies' health. Some of the reasons our team loves Mosh & Moshy include:

  • Freedom and flexibility to work the way you want, including fully remote
  • Flexible session structure aligned to patient demand
  • Established patient base and operational infrastructure
  • Structured clinical governance and peer support
  • Opportunities to advance your career as the business grows
  • Working with a friendly and talented team

Better together

Everyone is different and we think that’s what makes life interesting. We believe these differences create new ideas, offer unique perspectives and speak on behalf of all of our customers. If you think you have what it takes but don't check all the boxes, reach out anyway - we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
MCM Technology has spent 20+ years building the intelligent operations readiness platform trusted by public safety agencies nationwide. What started as a small family business building software for two-way radio dealerships has grown into a connected, AI-enabled platform used by 300+ agencies across the country, managing more than $5 billion in assets.

MCM helps law enforcement, fire, EMS, and government and communications agencies track assets, manage certifications, and stay audit-ready, giving agencies real-time visibility, automated workflows, and predictive intelligence so their teams can stay focused on the field instead of chasing paperwork. MCM's platform covers asset tracking, maintenance and inspections, certification and training, evidence, and fleet management, all built by a team that develops and supports the product in-house.

MCM's mission is to help agencies know not just what they own, but what's at risk before anything goes wrong, building software that works as hard as the people who depend on it.

About the Role

MCM Technology is looking to hire a Partner Channel Manager to build, grow, and manage a network of reseller and strategic partners that extend MCM's reach across the public safety market. This role owns the full partner lifecycle: recruiting and onboarding new partners, enabling and training their sales teams, opening senior-level and engineering relationships that deepen a partnership over time, and establishing the cooperative purchasing vehicles that make MCM easier for agencies to buy. This role does not carry an individual sales quota. MCM's direct sales team closes the business. This role is measured on its contribution to partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and on the partnership milestones that create it. This is a full-time, remote role with up to 40% travel, reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer.

What We Value in You

  • You understand the public safety market: law enforcement, fire, EMS, radio and communications, and can speak credibly to its buyers and influencers.
  • You're a relationship builder who knows how to motivate a partner's sales team to prioritize and sell your solution alongside their own.
  • You have a "can do" attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines.
  • You're never tired of learning and are always looking for ways to grow personally and professionally.
  • You're both an effective communicator and an eager listener.
  • You want to be an active part of helping our team continue to be at the forefront of how we serve public safety. You bring your energy and expertise to the table every day. We are stronger working together as a team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and execute a partner channel strategy that includes managing MCM’s current partners, as well as identifying and recruiting new partners to extend MCM's coverage of the public safety market.
  • Establish and manage onboarding, training, and enablement programs so partner sales teams can effectively position and MCM's platform.
  • Own a contribution target for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline. MCM's direct sales reps close the business; this role creates the joint pipeline that feeds them and works with partners to advance it.
  • Effectively and efficiently document and track all partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities in Salesforce CRM to ensure accurate forecasting and pipeline evaluation.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partners, resolving conflicts, coordinating deal support, and ensuring a consistent, positive partner experience.
  • Work cross-functionally with the Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success teams to ensure partner-sourced deals and post-sale handoffs are well-supported.
  • Develop joint business plans with key partners, including account mapping, co-marketing, and shared pipeline-generation activities.
  • Build and operate MCM's deal registration process together with the Chief Revenue Officer, including rules of engagement, how credit is assigned between a partner and a direct rep, conflict resolution, and tracking in Salesforce. This process does not exist today and building it is a first-year deliverable.
  • Evaluate which partnerships justify engineering investment and coordinate integration scoping between the partner's technical team and MCM Product. Bring a business case for the integration, not just a request.
  • Open and maintain senior-level relationships inside partner organizations, including executive sponsor mapping and regular business reviews, so a partnership survives turnover on either side.
  • Own the Zebra relationship, including expanding it beyond the initially approved scope and driving hardware attach alongside MCM's direct sales team.
  • Build and own MCM's presence on cooperative purchasing and contract vehicles such as Sourcewell, GSA, NASPO, and state term contracts. MCM does not hold some of these today. This role owns the relationship and decides which vehicles to pursue; MCM's Contracts Manager owns pricing and contract terms.
  • Renegotiate agreements with existing partners who resell MCM, working with the Contracts Manager on margin, terms, and minimums.
  • Lay the groundwork for MCM reselling partner products beginning in 2027, including margin structure, who owns support, and how the offering is packaged and quoted.
  • Stay up to date with relevant industry and job knowledge by attending conferences, participating in educational opportunities, reading professional publications, maintaining personal networks, and participating in professional organizations.
  • Effectively communicate the value and features offered in the software solutions partners are selling, including the ability to perform introductory level demonstrations of the software at tradeshows or in partner sales meetings.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience building and managing partner/reseller channels and enabling their sales teams.
  • A track record of generating measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and of being held accountable for it.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; good at establishing rapport, and building trust.
  • Experience navigating complex, multi-party sales cycles involving both a partner organization and an end-customer.
  • Ability to write clearly and communicate effectively via email and in person.
  • A self-starter with the ability to solve problems independently.
  • An effective multi-tasker, comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong emphasis on data integrity for pipeline accuracy, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Values metrics and maintains strong organization skills.
  • Ability to translate a technical integration request into a business case, and to run a joint call between two engineering teams without needing an engineer to lead it.
  • Comfort building a program from nothing. Deal registration, partner tiering, and contract vehicle applications do not exist here yet.

Nice to Have's

  • Direct experience in law enforcement, fire, or EMS, or technology sales experience specifically serving those agencies.
  • Existing relationships with resellers, integrators, or channel partners active in the public safety market.
  • Experience using Salesforce (training will be provided for candidates without prior experience).
  • Experience with cooperative purchasing vehicles such as Sourcewell, GSA, NASPO, or state term contracts, including the application and renewal process.
  • Experience structuring a reseller agreement from the vendor side, including margin, support ownership, and minimums.

Other Reasons to Join Us

  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance starting Day 1

•401(k)

•Use what you need PTO policy

•Health Savings Account (HSA) option

•Flexible Spending Account (FSA) option

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:


The Senior Manager, Digital Clinical Operations is responsible to enhance Global Clinical Operations productivity and reduce clinical trial inefficiencies, by detailing the business-critical capabilities from Clinical Study Startup to Study Close Out with focus on use of Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) and other digital solutions. This role will specifically focus on following activities:

  • Detail enhancements for existing CTMS and other digital solutions used by the GCO teams in Planning, Start-up, Managing and Closing clinical trials, and ensure data are fit for intended decision-making.
  • Engage with clinical stakeholders across geographies and functions, to create a clear voice of the clinical teams for the purpose of the delivery of CTMS enhancements.
  • Elicit clear requirements from stakeholders, ensuring organizational alignment, regional alignment, and process alignment (process standardization, optimization & automation)
  • Facilitate the prioritization of demand, managing competing interests with objective assessment of value. Ensure that priorities are aligned to organizational priorities. Create transparency into priorities with clear communication to stakeholders. Translate priorities into plans in collaboration with the development team. Manage expectations with stakeholders (leadership and requestors).
  • Draft & finalize business requirements for prioritized enhancements
  • Coordinate with the Development & IT teams to refine and finalize user stories for functional requirements, participate in sprint planning, sprint testing, SDLC testing including UAT
  • Ensure that the CTMS and other digital applications are aligned to GCO processes. As part of requirement gathering, ensure that related business processes are well defined and probe into process optimization or process solutions where appropriate, to complement digital solutioning. In cases where process is not defined, create process flows aligned with proper functions and leadership.
  • Support the strategic evolution of the CTMS and other digital solutions with near-term and long-term roadmaps.
  • Define and articulate the value proposition of all requests, in both quantifiable and qualitative categories.
  • Define, track and share business outcome value measures for digital investments
  • Represent GCO business interests as a key member of the implementation team.
  • Review proposed designs to ensure that solutions are architected to meet the actual need and expected value.
  • Curate the backlog of demand, ensuring that the user stories and priorities are up to date.
  • Manage the network of champions, fostering two-way communication between end-users and the product team.
  • Setup and maintain a website (SharePoint) for communication with end-users and champions.
  • Bring innovative approaches and technology from industry emerging trends and past experience.
  • The incumbent will work directly with GCO clinical stakeholders, Development and IT organizations and support implementing novel technology solutions, processes, and roles & responsibilities.

Essential Functions of the job:

General expectations of a Digital Clinical Operations employee

  • Forge relationships with users to understand their requirements and processes, identify automation opportunities, collaborate with development/vendor team to create the necessary fit-for-purpose solutions.
  • Drive the analysis of the technology and industry trends to identify specific opportunities that ensure BeOne clinical trials and operations are conducted with fit-for-purpose, cost-effective and innovative solutions that are cohesive, efficient, reliable, and compliant with all applicable regulatory expectations.
  • Implement the GCO technology roadmap to increase Global Clinical Operations’ productivity, reduce rising costs of clinical trials, and reduce clinical trial inefficiencies
  • Monitor, evaluate, and optimize the performance and quality of the technology solutions, as well as troubleshoot and resolve any issues that may arise
  • Project Management: ensure forward progress, timelines are managed, accountabilities are clear, and project risks and costs are managed.
  • Promote a culture that exemplifies agility, compliance, process-orientation, data-driven decision-making, and thoughtful use of technology and innovation
  • Partner with internal BeOne departments, including Development Data Science, QA and IT, to support the development of documentation associated with computerized systems, including lifecycle management for existing systems, and the implementation of innovative new systems
  • Develop solution requirements and standards in alignment with stakeholders (Clinical Operations, Data Management, Supply Chain, etc.).
  • Identify pain points and manual workflows, and develop technological solutions that address these challenges, leveraging existing and innovative approaches.
  • Take accountability for business value realization of technology solutions. Ensure that appropriate change tactics are planned and effectively delivered (communications, training, user communities, adoption drives) for both internal and external users. May directly involve development and delivery of these tactics.
  • Focus on user expectation and satisfaction and decreasing user burden. Proactively ensure system usability and user needs remain a high priority.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Be an individual contributor
  • Oversee consultants or analysts on a matrixed team (as needed)

Technical Skills:

  • Requirement gathering and documentation
  • Process modeling
  • Familiarity with clinical operations applications e.g. CTMS

Soft skills:

  • Stakeholder management: Ability to work collaboratively with functional leadership and external partners, to forge partnerships and collaborations arrangements. Ability to manage expectations, to communicate to broad groups of end-users.
  • Communication: Exhibits strong cross-cultural awareness, and strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey complex insights to non-technical stakeholders
  • Cross-functional oversight: Ability to collaborate with cross-functional clinical teams to understand their business needs and deliver outcome-aligned solutions. Partner with internal BeiGene departments, including Development Data Science, QA and IT, to develop standards, policies, and procedures associated with computerized systems, including lifecycle management for existing systems, and the implementation of innovative new systems.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent conceptual, analytical, and problem-solving skills to identify trends and make data-driven decisions. Troubleshooting skills.
  • Able to drive forward progress

Education/ Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or related degree
  • 7+ years’ experience in drug development clinical trial operations
  • Clinical Operations domain expertise
  • Business analysis on technology projects
  • Core clinical systems
  • SDLC
  • Validated systems
  • Familiarity with data processing / engineering is a plus

Travel:

  • As needed

Salary Range Canada:

140,900.00 CAD – 176,100 CAD

Please note that this job posting is being advertised to fill a budgeted position.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. BeOne does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

raw.title: Expert Product Manager – Netwrix Auditor
raw.excerpt: About Us At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control.
raw.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Role Overview

We are seeking an accomplished, seasoned Lead Product Manager to define and drive the strategy for Netwrix Auditor - the compliance audit and security-investigation backbone of Netwrix Security. In this role, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and go-to-market execution for the highest CSAT rated product in the company's portfolio, and its migration to a true multi-tenant SaaS offering.

The ideal candidate combines deep product management expertise with strong knowledge of data security posture management, compliance auditing and regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, CMMC, SOC 2), plus fluency in the SIEM, SOAR, and SOC technologies (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, ServiceNow, and similar) that security operations and compliance teams rely on every day. You will act as the voice of the customer, ensuring Netwrix Auditor delivers curated, audit-ready evidence for compliance teams and near real-time alerting with rapid, interactive forensic investigation for SecOps analysts — activity, access, and configuration-change auditing across Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, file servers, databases, and cloud infrastructure, with advance DSPM capabilities in support of that mission.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define the vision and long-term strategy for Netwrix Auditor, aligned with company priorities and the compliance-audit and security-operations market.
  • Own the product roadmap, including backlog prioritization and release planning, closing on-premises-to-SaaS parity gaps that unlock migration of the Auditor installed base.

Market & Customer Insights

  • Own the Auditor’s GTM strategy and partnership strategy with the Data Security solution suite, driving Auditor attach on cross-portfolio opportunities, and brief industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester) to sharpen Auditor’s competitive and category positioning.
  • Conduct ongoing discovery with internal auditors, compliance officers, and SecOps/SOC analysts to identify requirements for audit evidence, framework mapping, and investigation workflows.
  • Track the competitive and analyst landscape (Gartner, Forrester, and others) across compliance auditing and SIEM/SOAR-adjacent categories to inform positioning.

Product Execution

  • Partner with engineering to deliver curated, audit-ready compliance capabilities mapped to frameworks such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, CMMC, and SOC 2, alongside real-time alerting, rapid forensic investigation, behavioral analytics (UEBA), and AI-driven threat detection and response capabilities.
  • Ensure deep integration with SIEM, SOAR, and SOC ecosystems (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, ServiceNow) for alert export, extended schema, and workflow/action orchestration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales and Customer Success on the Auditor-to-1Secure SaaS migration motion, protecting and growing the largest single renewal base in the portfolio.
  • Define and monitor product success metrics, including renewal rate, audit-preparation time reduction, investigation mean time to resolution, and SaaS conversion rate.

Innovation

  • Champion AI-driven investigation and compliance-reporting automation, including anomaly and threat-pattern detection layered onto activity and change data.
  • Ensure Netwrix Auditor's DSPM capability dovetail into the broader Netwrix DSPM story, and the 1Secure SaaS platform vision, while deepening the product's compliance and SIEM/SOAR/SOC story, and laying the groundwork for advance Threat-Detection capabilities.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 4 years in cybersecurity, data security, threat detection & response, security-investigation products, compliance auditing, IT audit, or SIEM/SOAR/SOC solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of DSPM, Data Access Governance, or adjacent domains (DLP, IGA, compliance automation, risk management).
  • Strong knowledge of compliance frameworks (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, CMMC, SOC 2) and how audit-ready reporting and evidence are built and maintained.
  • Deep familiarity with SIEM, SOAR, and SOC technologies and integration patterns (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, ServiceNow) — alerting, schema/export design, and workflow/action orchestration.
  • Demonstrated success migrating or modernizing a mature on-premises product into a true multi-tenant SaaS offering while protecting a large, high-renewing customer base.
  • Comfortable owning a true multi-tenant SaaS product and the operating cadence — continuous delivery, telemetry-driven prioritization — that comes with it.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

 

Our Values

At Netwrix, our values guide every action:

  • Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
  • Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
  • Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
  • Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
  • Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
  • Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
  • eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

  • Competitive Health Benefits
  • Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
  • Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
  • Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
  • Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Please let us know if you require any accommodation.

About The Job

Want to teach online Polish courses to corporate students from all around the world?

With our flexible scheduling, you can teach adult students at a time that suits you.

We will make sure that you have the necessary tools and materials to help you be the best teacher you can be.

  • Be your own boss. You decide when you can teach

  • Teach a variety of levels, during work hours

You need to meet the following requirements to start:

  • Fully fluent Polish speaker (C2 equivalent).

  • Currently able to work as an independent contractor (freelance).

  • Bachelor’s degree. You should have a completed bachelor’s degree.

  • Minimum 120 hours Polish language teaching qualification.

  • Previous teaching experience, preferably in a corporate setting.

**Please submit your CV in English. CVs in other languages will not be considered**

About EF Teach Online

EF Teach Online is a division of EF, a global leader in language learning with more than 60 years of educational innovation. We deliver high‑quality online learning through a world‑class digital platform that reaches students around the world.

Our teams operate at the intersection of education, technology, and global operations—working across time zones to enhance our platform, improve learner engagement, and support thousands of educators and students every day.

Joining EF Teach Online means contributing to a mission‑driven, international organization focused on opening the world through education within a dynamic, innovative, and collaborative environment.

About EF Education First

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

Learn more about life at EF: LinkedIn | Instagram | TikTok

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Release Train Engineer / Developer

About the role

We are hiring a Release Train Engineer / Developer with strong mainframe skills to coordinate and deliver releases across a major lending platform built on FIS ALS. This is a delivery-and-coordination role at the centre of the programme: you will orchestrate the release train across development, testing, infrastructure and business teams, and act as the communication bridge between Product Management, Product Owners, Scrum Teams, business users and leadership.

Work authorization

This role is open to candidates with EU/EEA citizenship or existing, unrestricted right to work in the EU — no visa sponsorship is provided. We are particularly keen to hear from candidates holding a Romanian, Polish, Bulgarian, Czech, Portuguese or Spanish passport (or other EU member state passport). This is a fully remote role.

Responsibilities

Release coordination

  • Coordinate release schedules across ALS development, testing, infrastructure and business teams.
  • Plan and orchestrate SIT, UAT, Pre-Production and Production deployment activities.
  • Manage ALS upgrades, patches and vendor (FIS) releases.
  • Ensure regulatory and compliance-related changes are delivered on schedule.

ALS-specific delivery

  • Coordinate change across ALS modules: Loan Origination, Credit Administration, Commercial Lending, Loan Servicing, and interfaces with Core Banking and Treasury systems.
  • Collaborate with FIS/vendor support teams, business SMEs, testing teams and infrastructure teams.
  • Manage code promotion, environment readiness and cut-over planning.

Communication & governance

  • Act as the bridge between Product Management, Product Owners, Scrum Teams, business users and leadership.
  • Track dependencies, risks and readiness across the release train; represent changes at change-approval forums (CAB).

Requirements

Essential skills

  • Strong mainframe skills — COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2 (and ideally Coolgen / IEF, the technology underpinning ALS).
  • Experience coordinating releases across dev, test, infrastructure and business teams.
  • Hands-on planning of SIT / UAT / Pre-Prod / Production deployments and cut-over.
  • Exposure to FIS ALS or a comparable lending / core-banking platform.
  • Change and configuration management (e.g. Endevor / Changeman), scheduling (Control-M / CA7), Connect:Direct.
  • Comfortable managing tiered environments (Dev / Test / UAT / Pre-Prod / Production / DR).

Desirable

  • Release Train Engineer experience in a SAFe / Agile environment (PI planning, scrum-of-scrums).
  • Lending domain knowledge (loan origination, servicing, commercial lending, credit).
  • Experience with vendor release cycles and patch management on a packaged banking product.
  • Core Banking and Treasury interface integration experience.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Long-term engagement on a high-visibility lending transformation.
  • Fully remote - nearshore working.
  • Competitive day rate (aligned to channel and discussed on application).

raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Au sein d’un centre de support dédié à la qualité des solutions, à l’agilité et au DevSecOps, vous contribuez au renforcement de la qualité des développements IT et à l’évolution des pratiques de test et de documentation.

La mission combine un volet méthodologique et un volet opérationnel, avec une intervention transverse sur la qualité des solutions IT, tant pour les développements internes que pour les livrables fournis par des prestataires.

Objet de la mission

  • Contribuer à l’application et à l’évolution de la politique qualité en matière de tests et de documentation.
  • Définir et mettre en place des stratégies visant à améliorer la qualité et le testing des solutions IT.
  • Promouvoir les pratiques qualité liées aux plans de test, scénarios, rapports d’exécution, qualité du code, tests unitaires et automatisation.
  • Soutenir la mise en place d’outils et de pratiques de test dans un environnement DevSecOps.
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes en charge de la définition des besoins pour les nouvelles applications, leurs évolutions et leur maintenance.
  • Coordonner, et si nécessaire prendre part à, la préparation des tests, y compris la conception et l’accompagnement à la rédaction.
  • Assurer le suivi de l’exécution des tests, la remontée des anomalies et le suivi de leur correction.
  • Contribuer à la production du plan de test maître au démarrage des projets de développement.
  • Superviser et réaliser des contrôles ponctuels de la qualité des livrables liés aux développements.
  • Formuler des recommandations en cas de non-conformité et veiller à leur bonne application.
  • Définir, avec les demandeurs, des seuils qualité mesurables et les formaliser sous forme de tableaux de bord et de rapports.
  • Rédiger des plans d’action liés au suivi des non-conformités et à l’amélioration continue.
  • Coacher et encadrer les coordinateurs de tests, testeurs et testeurs automatiseurs.

📝 Votre profil

  • Expérience confirmée en assurance qualité et contrôle qualité appliqués aux solutions IT.
  • Connaissance de l’outil d’automatisation de tests Playwright.
  • Expérience dans la définition et la mise en place de stratégies d’amélioration de la qualité et du testing des solutions IT.
  • Expérience pratique dans la mise en place d’une politique qualité liée au développement de solutions IT.
  • Expérience pratique de la mise en place d’une gouvernance et de bonnes pratiques de documentation sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie applicatif.
  • Expertise dans la mise en place et la coordination des tests de solutions IT.
  • Très bonne connaissance des méthodologies agiles de type Scrum.
  • Très bonne maîtrise des outils de gestion des tests, notamment Jira et Xray.
  • Très bonne maîtrise du français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
  • Bonne communication, assertivité et sens de l’écoute.
  • Vision stratégique avec une approche pragmatique des problèmes et des solutions.
  • Capacité rédactionnelle, esprit d’analyse, sens du détail et aptitude à la synthèse.
  • Autonomie, sens du service et capacité à travailler en équipe.

Méthode d’évaluation

Le candidat sera évalué lors d’un entretien, organisé via Teams ou en présentiel.

L’échange portera sur le parcours, l’expérience, les compétences techniques et comportementales, ainsi que l’adéquation avec la mission.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

raw.description:
At RYZE Claim Solutions, we’re not just another claims company—we’re a people-first, solutions-driven organization built on integrity, teamwork, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We are hiring 1099 Quality Assurance Reviewers/Examiners to join our growing company. The Claims Examiner will support the organization’s mission to provide superb service and attention to our clients’ most important assets, their customers. The Claims Examiner will ensure a quality product is delivered to our client in a timely and professional manner by working alongside our field services staff and quality assurance counterparts. This position is responsible for performing quality assurance file reviews, following specific client estimating guidelines, and ensuring all estimates and reports are technically accurate.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Maintain contact with field adjusters to ensure timely inspection and estimate/report submissions
  • Review adjuster reports and estimates to ensure accuracy, meet appropriate industry standards, and adhere to client guidelines
  • Knowledge of insurance policies and endorsements for appropriate application of coverage
  • Clear and concise file documentation
  • Ability to work with Xactimate/Xactanalysis and collaborate on estimates
  • Respond timely and appropriately to all communication
  • Monitor and maintain individual queues to ensure that files are being reviewed and closed timely
  • Understand and work within multiple client systems, programs and guidelines; Guidewire knowledge preferable
  • Assist with training adjusters on client specific requirements when necessary
  • Ability to meet and exceed cycle time and quality review metrics
  • All other related duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Two or more years of related property claim handling experience.
  • Xactimate/Xactanalysis estimating platform experience
  • CoreLogic/Symbility experience a plus (Claims Connect and Mobile)
  • Decision making skills and the ability to work independently
  • Knowledge of claim lifecycle and attention to detail
  • Good organization and time management skills
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively
  • Proficient computer & typing skills - working knowledge of MS Office: Word, Excel and Outlook
  • Familiar with a variety of field concepts, practices and procedure

What’s in It for You?

Fully remote position – Work from the comfort of your home while staying connected with a top-tier team.

1099 Contracted position - Compensation is paid on a per file basis and is a 1099 contracted position.

Engaging and collaborative company culture – We believe in celebrating our wins and learning from challenges together.

Opportunities for professional growth – We support continued education and career development.

Competitive compensation and benefits package – Because we value and invest in our team.

If you’re a dedicated and detail-oriented claims professional looking for a company that appreciates your expertise and offers room for growth, this is the role for you.

Do you have the desire to analyze data and perform groundbreaking research to drive business outcomes? Nationwide has been using data to serve our members and drive business outcomes for almost 100 years.   • Document, investigate, reproduce, track, and validate software defects, enhancement requests, and customer-reported issues in collaboration with developers, product owners, support staff, and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate release changes through clear release notes and demonstrations of new features for customers, peers, and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience testing software applications, creating and executing test cases, validating expected results, documenting defects clearly, and applying strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to write clear defect reports, release notes, and customer-facing documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively with developers, support staff, product stakeholders, and other cross-functional team members.
  • Strong knowledge of PC and LAN environments, primarily using Windows Server and Windows operating systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to use software tools for data entry, analysis, documentation, presentations, and calculations.
  • Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently in a remote team environment.

Preferred Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and database concepts.
  • Experience with client/server, web, and mobile applications, including iOS and Android platforms.
  • Experience testing public safety, law enforcement, records management, CAD, mobile computing, or field reporting software.
  • Experience working in an Agile software development environment.
  • Experience using issue tracking, test management, or work management tools such as Jira.
  • Experience with source control concepts or tools.
  • Experience with API testing, integration testing, data validation, or test automation is a plus.
  • Experience with public safety or law enforcement software is a plus; prior SmartCOP software experience is especially helpful.

Desired Job-Specific Competencies and Skills

  • Strong curiosity and persistence when investigating software behavior and reproducing reported issues.
  • Strong customer empathy and an understanding of the importance of reliable software in mission-critical public safety environments.
  • Ability to think from the perspective of end users, including officers, dispatchers, supervisors, records personnel, and support staff, and apply diagnostic and problem-solving skills to develop logical, documented recommendations with the appropriate teams.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable information for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to balance quality, release timelines, customer impact, and team priorities.

raw.description:
Why join Swaarm?

Join a young and well-funded adtech startup with a remote-first culture. Since we launched Swaarm in October 2020, we have been providing innovative tracking and attribution solutions that enable agencies, advertisers, and networks to fully track and control their marketing efforts in real-time, ensuring profitable growth. Our mission is to equip customers with easy-to-use ad-tracking and measurement technology, allowing them to focus on growing their businesses with advanced data analytics and automation.

We’re now looking for a driven Sales Manager (China) to help accelerate our growth in the region. You’ll collaborate closely with experienced adtech operators and a leadership team with 15+ years of industry expertise. Reporting directly to the Head of Sales, you’ll play a key role in shaping Swaarm’s presence and momentum across China.

As we continue expanding into the Chinese market, this role will be instrumental in establishing our local client base and growing Swaarm's brand presence. We're particularly interested in candidates with experience working with outbound advertisers (especially China-based app and gaming companies expanding globally), domestic affiliate networks, CPI/CPA performance marketing platforms, and mobile measurement partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Kochava.

Your tasks

  • Work closely with the Head of Sales to shape and execute Swaarm’s global sales strategy with a focus on China
  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pitching to negotiation and closing
  • Pitch and sell Swaarm’s cutting-edge marketing and attribution platform to new and existing clients
  • Build strong relationships with advertisers, agencies, affiliate networks, and strategic partners across China
  • Represent Swaarm to global customers and act as an ambassador for our company and products
  • Carry a sales quota and strive to meet and exceed targets
  • Travel to customer meetings and industry events (can be up to 30%)

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in measurement, and/or mobile performance marketing within Ad Networks or Affiliate ecosystems. B2B SaaS sales experience is a strong plus
  • Familiarity with concepts like Tracking, Attribution, Ad Serving, and how they impact digital advertising businesses
  • Established relationships within China's mobile app, gaming, performance marketing, or affiliate ecosystem. Experience working with outbound advertisers, domestic affiliate networks, CPI/CPA platforms, or MMPs (e.g. AppsFlyer, Adjust, Kochava) is highly desirable.
  • Experience with CRM tools like HubSpot or similar
  • A proactive and curious mindset, not afraid to challenge the status quo, take ownership, and ask questions
  • A proven track record of managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals
  • Self-motivated, driven, and goal-oriented, always striving to exceed sales targets
  • Native or fluent Mandarin; strong written and spoken English required for HQ and global client communication

Benefits

  • Work from anywhere – we embrace a fully remote work culture that values flexibility
  • A collaborative culture built on openness, support, and knowledge sharing
  • Learn from and work alongside senior experts in adtech and sales
  • Own your client portfolio from day one and drive real impact
  • Attractive performance-based compensation and strong earning potential
  • Clear career-growth opportunities in a fast-growing Martech startup expanding across China

Ready to join a high-growth Martech team and make a real impact?

We’d love to hear from you!

raw.title: Web Developer, Artificial Intelligence Assisted Development
raw.excerpt: Rockstar is recruiting for a growing technology company that helps businesses increase their visibility and revenue through modern websites, search engine optimization, and generative engine optimization.
raw.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a growing technology company that helps businesses increase their visibility and revenue through modern websites, search engine optimization, and generative engine optimization. The company builds high-performance websites and develops tools that help businesses compete across traditional search engines and artificial intelligence platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and other emerging search experiences. They are a dynamic team focused on delivering top-notch technology and design.

About the Company

They're a growing technology company helping businesses increase their visibility and revenue through modern websites, search engine optimization, and generative engine optimization.

They build high-performance websites and develop tools that help businesses compete across traditional search engines and artificial intelligence platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and other emerging search experiences.

They're looking for a talented Web Developer with strong coding fundamentals who embraces artificial intelligence assisted development and can take ownership of website deployments, ongoing maintenance, and improvements across their growing portfolio of customer websites.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, part-time position for an experienced developer who knows how to write, understand, and troubleshoot code independently while using modern artificial intelligence tools to work more efficiently.

Cursor is a central part of their development workflow, and the developer will be encouraged to use it extensively to accelerate development. However, this is a coding position, not a prompt-only development role. Candidates must have a strong foundation in traditional web development and be capable of writing, reviewing, debugging, and modifying code without relying entirely on artificial intelligence.

The developer should understand how websites are structured, how the underlying code works, and how to identify and correct problems when artificial intelligence generated solutions are incomplete or incorrect.

The developer will work directly with the company's co-founders, with technical oversight from their Chief Technology Officer, who is also a co-founder. Primary responsibilities will focus on deploying new customer websites, maintaining existing websites, implementing updates, and resolving technical issues.

This role is focused on customer-facing website development and management rather than building or modifying the company's internal backend systems.

They're looking for someone who produces clean, professional code, communicates clearly, responds quickly, and can independently manage multiple website projects.

What You'll Do

  • Build, deploy, maintain, and improve customer websites using Cursor, GitHub, Netlify, and other modern development tools.
  • Write, review, debug, and maintain website code, using Cursor to accelerate development while ensuring all code meets professional standards.
  • Independently identify and resolve coding issues, including problems that cannot be solved through artificial intelligence generated suggestions alone.
  • Manage GitHub repositories, including creating and managing branches, committing changes, reviewing differences, resolving merge conflicts, and managing pull requests.
  • Handle website deployments through Netlify, including configuration, domain management, deployment troubleshooting, and hosting maintenance.
  • Implement website updates, new pages, design adjustments, integrations, and ongoing customer requests.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve website functionality issues, broken integrations, deployment errors, and performance problems.
  • Follow web security best practices, including secure configuration, dependency management, access controls, and protection of sensitive information.
  • Maintain clean, organized, well-structured, and professional code across customer projects.
  • Collaborate with the company's leadership to prioritize customer requests, meet deadlines, and maintain high standards of quality.
  • Ensure websites are responsive, fast, accessible, and compatible across modern browsers and devices.
  • Manage technical aspects of website launches, including domain configuration, redirects, forms, and third-party integrations.
  • Review and validate artificial intelligence generated code before deployment to ensure accuracy, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Respond promptly to technical requests, communicate project status clearly, and proactively identify potential issues.

What You'll Need

  • Strong professional experience in website development, including the ability to write and troubleshoot code independently.
  • Solid proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web development practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand website architecture, code structure, application logic, and development best practices.
  • Experience using Cursor or similar artificial intelligence assisted development environments to improve coding efficiency.
  • Strong proficiency with GitHub, including repository management, branching strategies, pull requests, merging, conflict resolution, and version control.
  • Hands-on experience with Netlify for website hosting, deployments, domain management, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to independently review, debug, modify, and improve code generated through artificial intelligence tools.
  • Strong understanding of website security principles and best practices.
  • Experience integrating website forms, analytics platforms, tracking scripts, and third-party services.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently and implement reliable solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to writing clean, professional, maintainable code.
  • Excellent communication skills, fast response times, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Astro Static Site Generator and static website architecture.
  • Familiarity with search engine optimization best practices, including technical website performance, structured data, redirects, and metadata.
  • Experience working with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console.
  • Experience with custom domains, domain name system configuration, secure connections, and website migrations.
  • Experience managing multiple customer websites simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with modern website performance optimization and Core Web Vitals.

Technology Stack

The company operates on a modern website development stack, including:

  • Cursor for artificial intelligence assisted development and code editing.
  • GitHub for version control, repository management, and collaboration.
  • Netlify for website hosting, deployment, and domain management.
  • Astro Static Site Generator for building fast, high-performance websites.
  • Internal tools for website management, reporting, and customer operations.

Experience with Cursor, GitHub, and Netlify is especially important. Familiarity with Astro is a strong advantage, although they're open to candidates with experience in similar modern frameworks who can learn their environment quickly.

What They're Looking For

They want a developer who combines strong coding skills with an artificial intelligence forward approach to development.

The ideal candidate is a capable web developer first and an effective user of artificial intelligence development tools second. The candidate should know how to code without Cursor, but recognize how tools like Cursor can make them significantly faster and more productive.

They're not looking for someone whose development experience is limited to prompting artificial intelligence tools and accepting the resulting code. The candidate must be able to understand what is being built, evaluate the quality of the code, identify potential problems, and make technical decisions independently.

The candidate should be comfortable taking a customer website request from initial requirements through development, testing, and production deployment with minimal oversight.

Responsiveness and reliability are particularly important. They work with a growing number of customers, and they need someone who communicates quickly, follows through on commitments, and takes pride in delivering clean, dependable work.

The developer will work closely with the company's co-founders, receive technical guidance from their Chief Technology Officer, and play an important role in delivering and maintaining the websites that power their customers' businesses.

Schedule

  • Hours: 20 to 30 hours per week
  • Location: Fully remote
  • Flexibility: Flexible scheduling, with an expectation of strong availability, prompt communication, and timely completion of customer requests

raw.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Lead the future of specialty insurance as our Executive Underwriting Director in Brokerage Excess. Drive strategy, financial performance, and growth for a regional Excess portfolio while building upon your existing strong broker and program manager relationships.


Join a collaborative, fast-paced E&S/S team where your leadership can shape solutions others can’t offer and grow your career with us!



Job Description Summary

Are you a leader who can create, develop and manage a strategy and plan that meets customer service and business goals? If you are driven to achieve top financial goals by managing the insurance underwriting business for a territory or region and seeking opportunities to build and grow business, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As a Director, Brokerage Excess, you will be responsible for the operating results of the assigned territory or region for the Excess Casualty line of business. This includes responsibility for monitoring all aspects of financial management of the assigned territory or region, influencing and managing relationships with brokers, program managers, and other producer channels, including exploring opportunities to drive more business. In this role, it’s essential to monitor trends and manage product issues within the territory or region for all assigned products. You will have the opportunities to participate in the development or revision of territorial or regional strategic plans and objectives. We will also count on you to contribute to the development of territory or region business strategy, execution of the business plan and attainment of goals and financial metrics as outlined in the business plan.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Risk Selection: proactively identify new market opportunities and help to drive through cross-functional product development processes. Participate in developing appetite guidelines for assigned territory and guidelines that apply to various risks. Proficiently write the most complex accounts independently. Granted expanded Letter of Authority.

  • Technical Underwriting: analyze exposure to loss, develop adequate premium, determine appropriate endorsements and exclusions. Proficient in policy terms/conditions, ability to manuscript coverage forms and understand the implications this will have on claims. Comprehensive understanding of catastrophe modeling. Mentor others with common and complex coverage forms. Analyze and interpret forms/coverages from other carriers and make appropriate recommendations to leader. Participate in research initiatives to enhance Technical Underwriting knowledge of the department. Analyze accounts to make independent recommendations to higher-level underwriters or managers (90% referrals approved as presented). Participate in helping to conduct Quality Control audits.

  • Broker Relations: Foster positive business relationships with brokers by maintaining frequent broker contact and developing rapport with brokers. Resolve broker conflicts without management or higher-level underwriter support. Provide recommendations to underwriting leadership regarding broker management. Provide support to others with sales and negotiation. Mentor others on developing and maintaining relationships with brokers.

  • Marketing: Independently conduct marketing visits. Drive broker conversations around Brokerage’s appetite, market/competitor conditions, and broker performance. Effectively relay marketing visit outcomes to manager and team and provides recommendations. Mentor others on concepts and skills for successful marketing visits. Take more-junior underwriters along for marketing visits and provides feedback to manager. Identify need for and help coordinate in-market receptions.

  • Territory Management: Analyze premium and losses of assigned brokers. Assess quality of broker submissions. Proactively take steps to maintain the book of business (rate, losses, coverage, appetite, etc.) within assigned territory. Examine and understand the underlying factors that are driving trends within the territory and broker performance. Identify the need for and drive broker management conversations (in conjunction with leaders). Recommend solutions to territory management issues. Provide feedback to management regarding strengths and opportunities around team performance.

  • Team Development: Find opportunities to develop the skills of others within the division. Demonstrate leadership qualities by consistently showing positive impact on and offering constructive feedback to team members. Act as substitute in lieu of manager for meetings or other ad hoc responsibilities. Contribute to higher-impact projects and initiatives throughout organization.

  • Production: Handle submissions of appropriate volume and efficiency, achieve premium and loss ratio goal. Help others on the team to meet their individual production goals.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to AVP. Direct reports include Underwriting professionals. Indirect reports not typically assigned.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate studies in a related discipline, or equivalent. Bachelor’s degree preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) designation preferred.

Experience: Eight years underwriting experience, handling large or complex programs and accounts preferred. Excess & Surplus lines experience preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of Excess & Surplus lines underwriting policies, practices and procedures, standard and alternative Rating plans and plan concepts, treaty & facultative reinsurance, regulatory issues, the general agency system, marketing principles and company operations. Ability to analyze and interpret mathematical, statistical and logical data, and evaluate its reliability and significance. Ability to communicate effectively, verbally, and in writing, inter personally with individuals and groups via telephone, fax, e-mail and in person. Ability to work with the wholesale/general agency distribution system. Ability to analyze complex problems and develop innovative creative solutions. Exceptional negotiation and communication skills and techniques. Ability to set work priorities that strategically align with departmental objectives. Ability to use/learn job related computer software.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Exempt (Not Eligible)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment. Travel will be required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

We currently anticipate accepting applications until 10/18/2026. However, we encourage early submissions, as the posting may close sooner if a strong candidate slate is identified before the deadline.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

Nationwide is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels challenged, appreciated, respected and engaged. Nationwide prohibits discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic (or classification) protected by applicable law.

Smoking is prohibited in all enclosed areas on or around company premises as well as company issued vehicles. raw.description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

Prospect Capital

Founded in 1988, Prospect Capital is an alternative asset management firm with $9.4B+ of assets under management, including permanent capital. Prospect pursues multiple strategies in the US, including direct lending, private equity, real estate private equity and structured credit. Prospect has a long-term, value-oriented approach that employs fundamental bottoms-up research to identify investments that offer attractive risk and reward.

Operating Executive Program

As an Operating Executive with Prospect, you will collaborate with our investment team to identify and pursue attractive acquisition opportunities across the U.S. Following a successful transaction, you will step into the role of President & CEO of the acquired company, taking full ownership of strategy and operations.

In this capacity, you will be accountable for overall P&L performance, designing and executing growth initiatives, and leading the company’s day-to-day operations. As the senior-most executive within the business, you will partner closely with Prospect and the company’s board of directors, playing a central role in shaping the company’s long-term direction and value creation.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 10 years of senior management experience, with a proven track record of successful P&L ownership and/or service as CEO, President, or General Manager.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead all aspects of a business, including strategy, operations, finance, and team development.
  • Strong track record of driving profitability and cash flow growth, with an emphasis on EBITDA generation.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the appetite to assume significant responsibility, balanced by the discipline to manage fiduciary obligations to diverse stakeholders.
  • History of proactively building revenue and increasing profitability through business development and growth initiatives.
  • Excellent professional references and a reputation for integrity and sound judgment.

Location:

Can be located anywhere in the U.S.

Are you looking for a rewarding career where you can change lives? Strayer University is seeking a dynamic Adjunct Faculty member to join our academics team. We are currently in search of a passionate professor for an online undergraduate/graduate levelaccounting class for the upcoming winter quarter, starting January 4, 2027.


Strayer Adjunct Faculty are not just instructors, they are also coaches and mentors. Our faculty members strive to ignite a life-long love of learning in our students and to be flexible with their diverse learning styles. We believe in a strong faculty-student relationship and building a community in the classroom.

NOTE: Applications must include copies of unofficial transcripts to receive full consideration.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Teach courses as assigned from a pre-designed curriculum and utilize your professional expertise to provide high-quality instruction.
  • Enhance the strength and effectiveness of the curriculum through the use of technology and videos.
  • Utilize the online learning platform to enrich the student learning experience.
  • Be available to students via email, phone, text, and office hours to ensure students receive quality feedback in a timely manner to support their academic success.
  • Establish high standards and ensure students understand how they will be evaluated.
  • Adhere to University policies and procedures.
  • Attend faculty meetings and workshops or training as required.

Job Skills:

  • Demonstrated knowledge of academic technology.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of academic evaluation.
  • Proficiency in oral presentation skills, planning, and organizing of course objectives.
  • Must have strong computer skills (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

  • Ability to manage potentially stressful situations in a professional and ethical manner.

Work Experience:

Education:

Other:
