Overview

Senior Product Owner

(Remote)

About Us:

Matrix Medical Network is the nation’s leading independent provider of comprehensive in-home health assessments, serving Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid and Commercial patients across all 50 states. With a network of 3,000 + clinicians, we deliver personalized Whole Person Care that includes diagnostic testing, risk identification, medication management and preventive health education, empowering people to better manage acute and chronic conditions. Guided by our mantra- We see you. We hear you. We’ve got you.- and our core values of Integrity, Accountability, Trust, Respect and Passion, we are committed to creating a culture where both patients and teammates feel valued, supported and heard.

Why Work at Matrix?

  • The opportunity to work with one of the fastest growing companies in healthcare whose vision is to provide unparalleled quality and value to providers and members.
  • A chance to work with great people on exciting projects.
  • Our opportunities allow you to leverage your expertise and compassion, making a direct impact to the health and well-being of members.
  • Competitive Compensation: Be rewarded for your effort and passion while making a difference in the community.

Responsibilities

About the role:

Type: Full Time, Salary

Compensation: $111,000-$166,000; Bonus 10%

Location: Fully Remote, must be in the United States

Hours: Full Time Days

Benefits Offered to include: Medical, Dental, Vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K with company matching, voluntary life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, additional voluntary benefits available.

What to Expect:

The Senior Product Owner is responsible for product direction, scheduling and access strategy, and conversion performance across this product area — the front door of the member journey, covering scheduling and access for in-home health assessments and primary care visits before a visit occurs. This role partners closely with a dedicated engineering team, central Data and Quality Assurance practice teams, and external scheduling and health plan partners to translate business and member needs into a scalable, high-converting scheduling experience. This role sits at a critical point in the organization’s ability to convert demand into scheduled visits: a gap in this role directly slows member access, scheduling throughput, and the revenue and quality outcomes that depend on it.

The Senior Product Owner collaborates with senior leadership to evaluate business priorities, shape the product roadmap, and prioritize enhancements aligned with organizational objectives. Leveraging data-driven conversion analysis, modern scheduling technology, and close engineering partnership, this role drives measurable improvements in member access, scheduling conversion, and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Core Platform Ownership

  • Own product direction and backlog for the core scheduling platform across its roadmap, including initial scheduling capability, in-home and telehealth assessment scheduling, and quality and care-gap closure visit scheduling.
  • Own product direction for the provider access and demand-capture scheduling engine, including geographic capacity balancing, progressive scheduling windows, and travel versus non-travel service rules.
  • Partner daily with the dedicated engineering team, writing requirements, prioritizing the backlog, and defining acceptance criteria alongside the team’s technical and QA leads.

Access & Conversion Strategy

  • Drive scheduling conversion initiatives, including real-time scheduling integrations with health plan partners and a broader partner API gateway strategy.
  • Own a structured conversion optimization framework — measure, diagnose, model impact, implement, and validate — to identify and close conversion and outreach gaps.
  • Use outreach and scheduling-acceptance analytics to prioritize technology and operational fixes affecting member reach and conversion.

Self-Service & Partner Enablement

  • Drive expansion of self-service scheduling, including SMS-based self-scheduling for assessments and primary care visits, and a member self-scheduling portal and preference center.
  • Own requirements for external scheduling and data partner integrations, including EHR platforms and third-party consumer scheduling networks, in partnership with engineering and partner organizations.

Delivery & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and release planning with the engineering team.
  • Partner with central Data and Quality Assurance practice teams on canonical data standards and test automation practices as they apply to this product area's systems.
  • Contribute domain requirements to the platform’s event-driven architecture as it matures.
  • Own business case and investment documentation for these initiatives, partnering directly with Finance and senior leadership.
  • Represent this product area in cross-functional and executive-facing planning, and serve as a functional mentor to other Product Owners across the organization.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree required (Business Administration, Health Informatics, Computer Science, or related field preferred).

Experience

  • 7–10 years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, including time owning a complex, high-visibility product area with significant autonomy.
  • Experience turning data into product decisions, including conversion funnel analysis, cohort or segment analysis, and prioritization grounded in measurable outcomes.
  • Experience writing clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria, and shaping technical backlogs at a senior level.
  • Experience partnering directly and daily with engineering teams in an Agile or Scrum delivery model.
  • Experience presenting to senior leadership and representing a product area in cross-functional planning.
  • Experience working with healthcare data and an understanding of HIPAA and protected health information (PHI) handling requirements.

Competencies & Skills

Core Competencies

  • Business Partnership
  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration
  • Backlog Management & Prioritization
  • Conversion & Outreach Optimization
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Problem Solving

Technical Skills

  • Agile / Scrum product ownership tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps)
  • Data analysis and reporting (SQL or equivalent)
  • API and system integration concepts
  • Healthcare scheduling or contact center technology
  • Generative AI and AI-enabled productivity platforms

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
  • SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM)
  • AI or Automation-related Certification

Our Culture:

  • We have a clear vision of where we are going, and we are guided by core values that embody our organization and our culture.
  • We emphasizes innovation and growth, and you will be given the opportunities and tools to develop personally and professionally.
  • We encourage and celebrate collaboration.
  • We have a deep commitment to positively impact the communities in which we work and to make a difference in the lives of who we serve.

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

raw.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking a Scrum Master to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) digital modernization and technology delivery initiatives.
raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Scrum Master to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) digital modernization and technology delivery initiatives. This full-time role provides hands-on Agile delivery leadership across multiple concurrent Scrum teams, helping multidisciplinary teams plan, execute, inspect, and improve work while maintaining clear visibility into commitments, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.

The Scrum Master IV will manage multiple Jira boards, facilitate core Scrum ceremonies, support backlog readiness, coordinate cross-team dependencies, remove impediments, and use delivery metrics to improve predictability and flow. The role partners closely with Product Owners, technical leads, designers, analysts, engineers, QA resources, and program leadership while preserving clear ownership of product, technical, and delivery decisions.

The successful candidate must operate beyond a single-team Scrum Master model. This individual should be comfortable balancing several teams, facilitating Scrum-of-Scrums and other cross-team coordination, improving Jira and Agile discipline, coaching teams toward greater self-management, and distinguishing team-level impediments from program-level dependencies. Strong facilitation, judgment, and data-informed delivery management are essential.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

• Serve as Scrum Master for multiple concurrent Scrum teams, adapting facilitation and coaching to each team's maturity, work type, composition, and mission priorities.

• Plan and facilitate sprint planning, daily Scrums, backlog refinement, sprint reviews/demos, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies; keep sessions focused, decision-oriented, and appropriately time-boxed.

• Own the day-to-day health of multiple Jira boards, including workflows, issue hygiene, sprint setup, statuses, dependencies, labels/components, dashboards, filters, and reporting views.

• Partner with Product Owners to maintain prioritized, actionable backlogs with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, sequencing, and readiness for upcoming sprints.

• Track commitments, sprint progress, blockers, carryover, scope movement, defects, and delivery risks; surface material issues early and facilitate resolution or escalation.

• Coordinate dependencies across Scrum teams and shared resources such as engineering, data, architecture, UX/HCD, QA, security, platform, and other delivery functions.

• Facilitate Scrum-of-Scrums, cross-team planning, dependency reviews, and release-readiness discussions when work spans several teams or shared milestones.

• Use delivery measures such as velocity, throughput, cycle time, lead time, work in progress, burndown/burnup, aging work, and carryover to identify trends and support continuous improvement.

• Coach teams on Scrum values, self-management, estimation, work decomposition, sustainable delivery, definition of ready/done, and effective retrospectives without becoming the team's task manager.

• Coach Product Owners and stakeholders on backlog quality, prioritization, acceptance criteria, sprint goals, scope tradeoffs, and appropriate engagement with delivery teams.

• Remove impediments within the Scrum Master's control and work with program leadership to resolve organizational, resource, approval, environment, access, and cross-team barriers.

• Connect sprint-level execution to broader milestones and release objectives while maintaining transparency about capacity, constraints, dependencies, and forecast confidence.

• Prepare concise, Jira-based delivery views for program leadership that emphasize progress, risks, dependencies, decisions needed, and forecast confidence rather than activity counts alone.

• Mentor less-experienced Scrum Masters or Agile practitioners and contribute reusable ceremony guides, Jira standards, metrics definitions, and team-health practices across the program.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, engineering, computer science, management, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Agile delivery, Scrum, software/digital delivery, project delivery, or related work, including significant hands-on experience serving as a Scrum Master.
  • Demonstrated experience simultaneously supporting multiple Scrum teams or workstreams with competing priorities, cross-team dependencies, shared resources, and different levels of Agile maturity.
  • Advanced hands-on Jira experience, including board configuration, workflows, filters/JQL, dashboards, sprint management, issue hygiene, dependencies, reporting, and troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate sprint planning, daily Scrums, refinement, reviews/demos, retrospectives, Scrum-of-Scrums, and other Agile coordination forums for technical and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of Scrum roles, events, artifacts, commitments, empirical process control, team self-management, iterative delivery, and the appropriate boundaries of the Scrum Master role.
  • Experience using delivery metrics to identify trends, diagnose flow or predictability problems, and coach teams toward measurable improvement.
  • Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies and impediments involving engineering, data, architecture, UX/HCD, QA, security, platform, product, or other shared disciplines.
  • Strong facilitation, conflict-resolution, stakeholder-management, and communication skills, including the ability to improve accountability without relying on positional authority.
  • Recommended certification: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM I or higher), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or comparable Agile credential.
  • Ability to successfully complete and maintain all required federal background investigation, suitability, and Public Trust requirements associated with the position, and comply with applicable VA security, privacy, training, records-management, and data-handling requirements.

Desired:

  • 9+ years of Agile or digital-delivery experience, including 5+ years serving as a Scrum Master, Senior Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or comparable role in complex enterprise environments.
  • Prior Department of Veterans Affairs, VHA, other federal, healthcare, or large regulated-enterprise delivery experience.
  • Experience supporting three or more concurrent Scrum teams and facilitating cross-team planning or Scrum-of-Scrums at scale.
  • Advanced Jira/JQL, Confluence, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Miro, Microsoft Teams, Power BI, or comparable Agile delivery and reporting tool experience.
  • Advanced certification such as PSM II/III, CSP-SM, SAFe Advanced Scrum Master, PMI-ACP, or comparable Agile coaching/delivery credential.
  • Experience coaching teams through maturity improvements, recovering underperforming teams, improving predictability, reducing work in progress, or resolving recurring carryover and dependency issues.
  • Experience supporting digital modernization, workflow transformation, data/analytics, automation, AI-enabled products, or other multidisciplinary technology initiatives.

Target Salary Range: $102,000 - $174,000

Disclaimer:

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Are you someone who can spot a winning YouTube angle before anyone else does?🎯

We're looking for someone who wants to build YouTube channels from scratch and watch them take off. You'll spot the topics and keywords worth chasing, launch new channels, produce content at scale, own the SEO and rankings, and keep testing until you find what actually works.

This is not a traditional content creator role. You’re expected to think like a YouTube growth/product manager not just produce videos. You'd be joining our YouTube department, a fully remote team that builds and grows channels across several markets, inside a digital media company that's been ranking content through SEO for years. 🚀

🏆 Our playing field is iGaming (online casino) one of the most competitive markets out there, and for that exact reason, one of the most rewarding.

Our business model is affiliate marketing: our channels send viewers to the brands we work with, and we get paid when they sign up. This makes performance very concrete. You rank, you get traffic, you generate sign-ups.

The role

It starts before any video exists: finding the keywords worth going after and studying what competitors rank for and why.
From there, you produce at scale: ideas, scripts, voice-over, thumbnails, publishing. Often remixing what you already have to test a new angle, rather than starting from a blank page.

Once channels are live, the work turns analytical: rankings, CTR, retention, signups. You read them and decide the next move.
Most tests won't work: That's the job. What matters is how fast you learn, and how quickly you scale what lands.

You'll use AI and automation throughout, and work within YouTube's policies as a regulated industry.

Where you'll spend your time:

  • Finding opportunities: keywords, search intent, competitors, channel angles
  • Building and producing: channels, content at scale, packaging
  • Outranking the competition: SEO, positions, CTR, retention
  • Converting: turning views into signups
  • Testing and adapting: scaling what works

Who we're looking for

We care more about how you think and what you can do than your degree or previous job title.

  • You're a heavy YouTube user and understand why some videos perform better than others
  • You're analytical and comfortable making decisions from numbers
  • You naturally think in terms of testing, measuring and improving
  • You're proactive and comfortable owning projects independently
  • You understand the basics of SEO, keywords and search intent
  • You're comfortable with content production and basic video editing
  • You already use AI tools and actively explore new ones
  • Native French, as you will write and record voice-overs for a French audience
  • Good English, as it is the working language of the team

You'll launch things that go nowhere, and watch good ideas underperform for reasons you can't explain yet. The people who do well here keep adjusting, and read a failed test as information.

A strong plus: you've already built a YouTube channel, website, social account or other digital project. Didn't work? That's fine. What we care about is what you learned.

What we offer

🎯 Real ownership — your own channels, your own decisions, your own numbers.

🚀 A head start — years of internal tools, automation and market data, yours from day one.

📈 Performance over seniority — several of our team leads started here in junior roles.

💰 Variable compensation — part of your pay follows how your channels perform.

🌏 Full remote — 35 hrs/week, flexible hours, at least 4 hrs overlapping Bangkok time.

🌴 Generous vacation leave

About GreenTomatoMedia

We're a digital media company based in Chiang Mai, Thailand, with 1,500+ websites across 8 languages, several million visitors every month, and a fast-growing YouTube department.

We don't work with clients or agency briefs. We build and grow our own products and brands, which means short decision cycles, real freedom to experiment, and the ability to see the impact of your ideas. 🌟

Our team brings together 45+ nationalities 🌎, and we believe a good idea should win because it works — regardless of who came up with it.

The Hiring Process

  1. Initial interview with HR that will last between 30-45 minutes.
  2. Practical test to evaluate your knowledge, and problem-solving skills.
  3. Final Interview with your potential team lead & reference check.

raw.description:
Role Title: Human Intelligence Collector (HUMINT)

Role Type: Contractor (at least ~15 hs a week)

Location: Remote, US-based preferred.

micro1 is engaging Human Intelligence Collectors to contribute their expertise in elicitation and investigative questioning on a specialized customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideal for those with a background in complex interviewing or intelligence collection, and a keen ability to interpret subtle verbal and behavioral cues. Your written and verbal communication skills will play a pivotal role as you document your reasoning and analysis for technical and non-specialist audiences alike.

Scope of Work

  1. Conduct or assess structured elicitation and interview sessions to extract accurate and relevant information from varied subjects
  2. Establish rapport with participants to encourage open communication without applying pressure or coercion
  3. Analyze responses in real-time, reading tone, pacing, and nonverbal cues, and dynamically adjusting questioning strategies
  4. Assess the internal consistency, reliability, and potential evasiveness of responses, providing confidence assessments for each interaction
  5. Identify and annotate emotional and motivational drivers influencing participants' responses
  6. Document your analytical reasoning in a clear, traceable manner to support downstream review and learning
  7. Score or annotate sessions according to a detailed rubric, maintaining objectivity and consistency across multiple cases

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 3–5+ years of experience in professional interviewing, intelligence elicitation, or investigative questioning (e.g., military HUMINT, law-enforcement interviewing, skilled negotiation)
  2. Training in recognized interviewing methodologies such as the PEACE model, cognitive interviewing, or similar frameworks
  3. Expertise in real-time interpretation of paralinguistic and nonverbal cues (tone, pacing, hesitation, gestures)
  4. Demonstrated ability to clearly justify analytical reads in writing, not just by intuition
  5. Exceptional written English skills with a focus on clarity, precision, and defensibility
  6. Experience working with diverse populations or through interpreters
  7. Familiarity with data annotation, AI model evaluation, or after-action/assessment report writing

raw.excerpt: About Tech9 At Tech9, we are driven by a clear mission—to empower organizations with AI-centered solutions that make them more adaptable, efficient, and future-ready.
raw.description:
About Tech9

At Tech9, we are driven by a clear mission—to empower organizations with AI-centered solutions that make them more adaptable, efficient, and future-ready. With proven expertise in product strategy, UX design, cloud architecture, and AI, our teams deliver purpose-built software that meets today’s needs and anticipates tomorrow’s challenges.

Headquartered in Utah, Tech9 experts collaborate across the United States, Latin America, and India. We offer a remote working environment with a collaborative and supportive culture, allowing you to focus on what you do best.

If you're excited by the opportunity to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment where scaling and building the future of software is key, we’d love to hear from you. Join us as we work together to redefine the world of software development.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on Technical Product Manager to lead the execution of digital product initiatives for a veterinary health organization. You'll be deep in the day-to-day product work: writing user stories, owning and prioritizing the backlog, and coordinating across multiple engineering, product, and business teams to turn stakeholder needs into clear, actionable work for engineering.

We are looking for a generalist who understands a product end-to-end rather than owning one narrow feature area. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be technical enough to understand integrations, APIs, and how interconnected systems communicate. Just as important, you'll want to get close to how the product is actually used in the wild, observing real user experiences and turning those insights into improvements, rather than managing everything from inside Jira. Clear communication is central to the job, since you'll regularly translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders and keep everyone aligned on progress, risks, and dependencies.

What You'll Do

  • Lead execution of assigned product initiatives from planning through implementation
  • Own the product backlog, prioritizing work based on business value, user needs, and technical dependencies
  • Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, business requirements, and product documentation
  • Observe how the product is used in real-world settings and turn those observations, along with stakeholder needs, into actionable work for engineering
  • Coordinate across multiple engineering, design, product, and business teams to deliver product enhancements and new capabilities
  • Support product discovery, roadmap execution, and release planning for assigned products
  • Evaluate technical solutions, third-party platforms, and system integrations, including how APIs and connected systems interact, to support product objectives
  • Manage delivery milestones, risks, and dependencies for assigned initiatives
  • Monitor product performance, analyze results, and recommend improvements based on data and user feedback
  • Coordinate product releases, implementation activities, and post-launch validation
  • Translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and delivery status
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of product management processes and practices

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 4+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, or in a similar technical product or program management role
  • Strong, hands-on experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Proven experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle
  • Experience working with APIs, system integrations, third-party platforms, and interconnected systems (engineering background not required)
  • Ability to understand and manage a product end-to-end across its systems and user workflows
  • Comfortable coordinating across multiple engineering, product, and business teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for translating between technical and non-technical audiences
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Asana, or similar
  • Background in healthcare, veterinary, or other multi-location service businesses

Nice to Have:

  • Experience using product analytics and user feedback to drive prioritization decisions
  • Based in the United States (preferred)

raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

Acerca de Abbott

Abbott es líder mundial en el cuidado de la salud, dedicado a crear ciencia e innovación tecnológica para mejorar la vida de las personas. En Abbott, puedes hacer un trabajo que importa, crecer y aprender, cuidar de ti mismo y de tu familia, ser verdaderamente quien eres y vivir una vida plena con prestaciones superiores a las de ley.

La Oportunidad

Buscamos un Key Account Executive Junior (KAE Jr) enfocado en la división de Pharma. En este rol, serás la pieza clave para asegurar la disponibilidad, colocación y negociación estratégica de nuestro portafolio de productos Abbott en las principales cadenas de farmacias (retailers) y mayoristas de tu territorio. Tu principal objetivo será impulsar un crecimiento sostenido de la participación de mercado a través del nuevo modelo comercial, manteniendo precios competitivos y garantizando los programas de descuento para pacientes.

Responsabilidades Clave del Puesto

  • Gestión Comercial y Negociación: Mantener y desarrollar una excelente relación comercial con los principales retailers a tu cargo y su red de farmacias (cobertura AAA, AA y A), ejecutando negociaciones diarias basadas en la parrilla promocional para alcanzar el 100% de la cuota mensual de ventas.
  • Administración del Territorio: Diseñar e implementar planes de trabajo eficientes utilizando herramientas de targeting estratégico para garantizar una secuencia óptima de visitas (promedio de 10 visitas diarias) en la ruta asignada.
  • Optimización de Inventarios y Sell-Out: Monitorear y analizar el sell-out de los clientes para identificar oportunidades de negocio. Controlar los datos de existencia y demanda para evitar faltantes de stock (out-of-stock) en farmacias, mitigando el riesgo de perder recetas médicas o caer en sobreinventarios.
  • Alineación Estratégica (Trade Marketing): Coordinar de forma interfuncional con los representantes de visita médica para desplegar proyectos conjuntos en el punto de venta, incluyendo iniciativas de Trade Marketing y desarrollo de nuevos canales de distribución.
  • Estrategia de Mercado: Anticipar los requerimientos del mercado regional y asegurar la correcta implementación del nuevo modelo comercial de la empresa.

Calificaciones Requeridas.

  • Educación: Licenciatura Concluida (Título Obligatorio) en áreas Económico-Administrativas, Mercadotecnia, Ciencias de la Salud o afín.
  • Experiencia: Mínimo 1 año de experiencia comprobable en el área de Ventas gestionando canales de Farmacias, Mayoreo, OTC o consumo masivo (idealmente en el sector farmacéutico).
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Manejo intermedio/avanzado de paquetería Office (especialmente Excel para análisis de bases de datos comerciales, sell-out e indicadores).
  • Competencias Core: Fuertes habilidades de negociación comercial, planificación estructurada, comunicación objetiva y alta orientación a resultados.

Sigue tus aspiraciones profesionales

Conéctate con nosotros a través de Abbott Careers

o en nuestras redes oficiales en LinkedIn y Facebook. Abbott es un empleador de igualdad de oportunidades comprometido con la diversidad laboral

N/A

raw.title: Key Account Manager, Albertsons - Phoenix, AZ
raw.excerpt: Job Description Summary: At The Coca-Cola Company, we exist to refresh the world and make a difference through loved brands, done sustainably for a better shared future.
raw.description:
Job Description Summary:

At The Coca-Cola Company, we exist to refresh the world and make a difference through loved brands, done sustainably for a better shared future. Working here is more than working for the global beverage leader; it’s an opportunity to be a part of something that can positively impact the world. Our North America Operating Unit (NAOU) Advanced Hydration division is a dynamic, fast‑paced business unit at The Coca‑Cola Company where teams come together to lead what’s next in hydration. With a portfolio that includes BODYARMOR Sports Drink, Powerade, vitaminwater, and smartwater, the group is driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, strong collaboration, and shared ambition. This is a place for people who think differently, move with agility, challenge the status quo, and thrive in an ever‑changing category. Joining the team means helping shape the future of hydration alongside passionate, collaborative teams committed to winning.

THE ADVANCED HYDRATION DIVISION is looking for a Key Account Manager, Albertsons to join our team.

The Key Account Manager, Albertsons, will lead a cross-functional team delivering business results across our Albertsons business on the west coast. This individual will provide subject matter expertise to resolve complex customer issues and deliver annual goals.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Customer Development

  • Strategic leader responsible for the Direct Customer/Business Management of the assigned customer.
  • Create and develop the vision and strategy to support both long-term and short-term business objectives.
  • This leader will exhibit subject matter expertise and demonstrate from experience they have successfully built and created joint business planning models for customers.
  • Drive processes and execution of annual plans across assigned customers and bottlers. Delivery of key business and financial metrics including topline results (Revenue, volume, Share) and key financial metrics (trade spend and T&E budgets) will be required.
  • Partner with Sr. Management and cross-functional team members to build Annual Plans to achieve both short-term and long-term business objectives.
  • Lead divisional annual negotiations ensuring an optimized partnership agreement is in place that supports overall organizational priorities.
  • Collaborative leader of a cross functional team responsible for the development and implementation of overall customer selling stories, while providing key insights to deliver key execution metrics (Pricing, Merchandising, and Innovation).
  • Oversee the on-going account updates and performance reporting against key metrics and problem solves plan gaps while bringing forward recommendations to deliver on required business objectives.
  • Develop and leverage top level external relationships to optimize brand positioning in the market.

System Leadership

  • Participate in all system routines as needed (Customer Core Teams) to provide customer updates including annual plan targets and elements and on-going customer performance updates and action plans to deliver annual plans.
  • Work closely with Coca-Cola NAOU + Bottler Customer Leads (Directors/AE’s) to maximize mutual customer plans, results, and execution.
  • Build and leverage relationships with both internal teams and Bottlers to ensure alignment and focus on delivering key customer objectives.

Cross Functional Communication and Collaboration

  • Provide on-going updates on customer plan results and opportunities to Advanced Hydration management.
  • Participate in key cross functional routines to provide on-going plan updates and ensure flawless execution of customer programs and initiatives.
  • Provide customer input to annual plans including all Marketing, Commercial and Innovation plans.

Organizational/People Development

  • Fully leverage all cross functional resources to deliver best in class capabilities to customers including selling stories, consumer and customer marketing and insights and revenue growth management plans.
  • Manage to an annual T&E budget for department ensuring alignment with internal financial objectives.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or relevant experience required.
  • 5 Years’ experience with National Account management experience building and executing JBPs with a customer required
  • CPG National Account Management experience required
  • Residence within the Phenix, AZ (within 50 miles) area required
  • Ability to utilize and mine syndicated data to translate into fact-based story telling required.
  • Must be self-motivated and highly organized with a powerful desire to produce results with an entrepreneurial spirit to succeed.
  • Must be able to quickly assess the needs of the business, develop an action plan & manage the required change. The ability to effectively intermingle with a wide variety of business professionals is essential.
  • Must have a passion for building brands, new products, and long-term growth.
  • Must have a verifiable list of current contacts with appropriate buyers & divisional managers.
  • Solid computer skills in Outlook, Power Point, Excel, and Word. Strong understanding and analytical skills in utilizing Nielsen/IRI syndicated data.
  • 30% Travel by car and/ or plane required
  • Must hold and maintain a valid driver's license and be able to drive long distances.
  • Motor Vehicle Records must satisfy Company standards per Driving Policy.
The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

Key Accounts

Base pay offered may vary depending on geography, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.

15

Annual Incentive reference value is a market-based competitive value for your role. It falls in the middle of the range for your role, indicating performance at target.

Drive Strategic Financial Decisions at a Global Technology Leader


GTT is a leading provider of secure global connectivity, helping organisations improve network performance and agility across people, applications, clouds, and locations worldwide. Through our global Tier 1 IP backbone and extensive portfolio of networking, security, and managed services, we support thousands of businesses on their digital transformation journeys.

We are seeking a Lead Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis to join our Finance team. This is a highly visible role that combines strategic thinking, advanced analytics, and business partnership. The successful candidate will provide financial insights that influence decision-making at senior levels and help drive business performance across the organisation.


What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead the development of complex financial models, forecasts, and scenario analyses to support strategic business decisions.
  • Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights for business leaders.
  • Identify key performance drivers and recommend opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders across the business to provide financial guidance and strategic support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align financial planning with operational objectives and long-term business strategy.
  • Develop and deliver executive-level reporting, dashboards, and performance analysis.
  • Drive continuous improvement in financial reporting processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Present complex financial information in a clear and commercially relevant manner.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and initiatives that support organisational goals.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior analysts, promoting analytical excellence and professional development.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Financial Analysis, or a related finance role.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power BI.
  • Strong financial modelling, forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis experience.
  • Deep understanding of financial statements and business performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders through data-driven insights and recommendations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FP&A experience within technology, telecommunications, SaaS, or other subscription-based revenue environments.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems and financial planning applications.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and mentoring colleagues.

Why Join GTT?

  • Be part of a global organisation operating at the forefront of networking and technology.
  • Influence strategic decisions through high-impact financial analysis.
  • Partner directly with senior leaders across the business.
  • Work in a collaborative, fast-paced, and data-driven environment.
  • Develop your leadership skills while helping shape the future direction of the organisation.

About GTT

GTT provides secure global connectivity, improving network performance and agility for people, places, applications, and clouds. We operate a global Tier 1 internet network and deliver a comprehensive suite of SD-WAN, networking, security, voice, and managed solutions. Our customers benefit from a customer-first approach supported by our commitment to operational excellence.


Equal Employment Opportunity

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

About Adlib

Adlib is the document-to-decision engine for regulated industries. Our AI agents turn the documents and emails work arrives as into accurate, auditable decisions, with every value traced to its source. In September 2026 Adlib acquired Paperbox, the mail-to-decision engine for insurance, trusted by more than 100 European insurers. Together we serve a global customer base across insurance and other regulated industries, backed by Diversis Capital.

The role

We are hiring a VP, Global Marketing to lead marketing across North America and Europe. You will own marketing-sourced pipeline for insurance and marketing’s retention and expansion targets for our installed base, lead the brand through the next phase of the company’s evolution, and build the North American demand engine on a proven European playbook. You are quantitative and data driven: every program has a number, every dollar has a return. You will run an AI-powered marketing function, using the latest AI tools across content, campaigns, outbound and operations, and bring creative energy to a category where most vendors sound the same. You will lead a senior team spanning marketing operations, field marketing in North America and Europe, and GTM engineering, and partner closely with Sales, Product and Customer Success.

What you will do

  • Pipeline: own marketing-sourced pipeline, coverage and conversion targets for insurance, globally
  • Installed base: own marketing’s retention and expansion targets for customers outside insurance; customer, partner and lifecycle marketing that supports renewal and growth
  • North America: build the demand engine, field and event led, replicating the European playbook that won our first 100 insurers

  • AI-powered marketing: run the function on the latest AI tools, including Claude and Regie.ai, across content, campaigns, outbound, account intelligence and reporting; more output per person, measured

raw.description:
Shift Markets builds white-label trading infrastructure for FX brokers, crypto exchanges, iGaming operators and fintechs. Founded in New York in 2009 with roots in FX technology, we have helped 250+ exchanges and brokerages go live, with more than $2 trillion in total volume traded and 10 million registered end users on our platform. Our clients add crypto trading, payments, and prediction markets without rebuilding their stack.

We are a global team with a shared mission to innovate in crypto infrastructure. Whether collaborating in office, connecting remotely, or representing Shift at industry events, we work together as one to move finance forward. We believe collaboration fuels creativity, diversity drives strength, and curiosity keeps us ahead of the curve.

Every great company is built by great people. Join us to help shape the future of digital asset infrastructure.

About the Role

This is a senior, hands-on role working directly with our marketing lead as his right hand. You will own B2B demand generation end-to-end (paid media, landing pages, email, and the funnel through to Sales) and you will build the AI systems that let a small team produce the output of a much bigger one.

We are not looking for someone who asks an AI tool to write a social post. We are looking for someone who has built workflows that monitor the market, competitors, and industry news, surface insights proactively and draft assets for human review, and who has the marketing judgment to know what good looks like.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own B2B paid acquisition across LinkedIn and Google: campaign builds, targeting, creative testing, conversion tracking and budget allocation.

  • Audit our ad accounts and website early on, cut wasted spend and fix what is underperforming.

  • Build and optimise landing pages and run CRO tests across the funnel: ad, landing page, form, CRM, email nurture, Sales handoff.

  • Report on what matters: qualified leads, pipeline and revenue, not just clicks or cost per lead.

  • Design, build and maintain AI workflows for research, competitor and news monitoring, content drafting and reporting, with human review before anything goes live.

  • Lead Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) so Shift shows up when buyers ask ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI engines about crypto infrastructure.

  • Oversee AI-assisted content and social output with support from junior team members.

  • Contribute to brand, PR, events, partnerships, podcasts and industry publications, and help shape quarterly marketing plans, including campaigns for new verticals such as online gaming operators and prediction markets.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on B2B digital marketing, with recent personal ownership of paid campaigns on LinkedIn.

  • Concrete results you personally drove: spend, acquisition costs, pipeline and revenue.

  • Hands-on experience building landing pages and running conversion tests.

  • Email marketing and CRM experience (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar), including nurture and lead routing.

  • AI workflows or automations you have built and use in your marketing work today. Be ready to show them.

  • Strong marketing judgement and clear, specific written communication.

  • Comfortable as a hands-on individual contributor in a small team.

Bonus Points

  • AEO, SEO or generative-engine optimisation experience.

  • Experience in crypto, fintech, payments, iGaming or B2B SaaS.

  • Earlier-career content or social media experience.

  • Zapier, n8n or similar automation tools; dashboards and data visualisation.

Why join Shift?

  • Direct impact: you work alongside the marketing lead, and your decisions ship in days, not quarters.

  • An AI-forward team that expects you to build systems, not just use tools.

  • A front-row seat in crypto infrastructure, prediction markets and payments as they reshape finance.

  • A global, remote team with flexibility across time zones.

This is a remote, 40-hour-per-week role. The successful candidate must maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with the New York team.

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Dublin, Ohio

Salary:

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

Job Title: Conversion & Creative Strategist

Reporting To: VP of Growth / Founder

Job Summary

The Conversion & Creative Strategist at Triquetra Health is responsible for owning the messaging, positioning, and conversion strategy behind Triquetra’s product catalog across Amazon, Shopify, paid media, and other digital channels.

This role exists to bridge the gap between science and conversion—translating complex product mechanisms into clear, persuasive messaging that resonates with real buyers and drives measurable business results.

As the owner of the strategic argument behind every product, the Conversion & Creative Strategist develops positioning frameworks, messaging architecture, conversion hypotheses, and testing strategies that improve customer understanding and increase conversion performance. This role works closely with design, paid media, content, and leadership teams to ensure product messaging remains clear, consistent, and performance-driven across every customer touchpoint.

This is not a design role. The primary responsibility is owning what we say, why it matters, and how it converts.

Duties & Responsibilities

Messaging Strategy & Positioning

  • Own the positioning and messaging architecture for Triquetra’s hero products and product lines across all major channels
  • Develop clear, compelling product narratives that translate complex health and wellness science into customer-first messaging
  • Ensure consistency of messaging across Amazon listings, Shopify product pages, landing pages, paid ads, and creative assets
  • Refine value propositions, core claims, product angles, and differentiators to improve buyer trust and conversion

Conversion Optimization & Testing Strategy

  • Build and manage a structured conversion testing framework across product pages, landing pages, and marketplace listings
  • Develop hypotheses based on performance data, customer behavior, and competitor insights
  • Prioritize testing opportunities based on expected impact, business goals, and channel performance
  • Continuously analyze conversion metrics, test results, and funnel performance to identify growth opportunities
  • Translate winning concepts into repeatable conversion strategies across product categories

Creative Strategy & Brief Development

  • Convert product insights, performance data, and competitive intelligence into actionable creative briefs
  • Provide strategic direction for designers, video editors, UGC creators, and content partners
  • Ensure briefs clearly define target audience, messaging angle, objections, emotional drivers, and desired conversion outcome
  • Collaborate with creative teams to improve execution quality and performance alignment

Competitive Intelligence & Market Analysis

  • Conduct ongoing analysis of competitor product pages, listings, funnels, creative strategies, and conversion tactics
  • Monitor trends in supplements, wellness, ecommerce, and DTC marketing
  • Build and maintain a structured swipe file and competitor intelligence system
  • Translate competitor learnings into actionable testing opportunities and strategic recommendations

Performance Analysis & Growth Insights

  • Measure and evaluate the effectiveness of messaging, campaigns, and creative concepts using key performance metrics
  • Identify which messaging angles drive stronger engagement, click-through rates, and conversion
  • Build feedback loops that continuously improve positioning and creative performance
  • Partner with leadership and growth teams to support data-driven decision making

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with design, paid media, ecommerce, product, and leadership teams to ensure strategic alignment
  • Support launch planning for new products, promotions, and campaigns with strong conversion-focused messaging
  • Contribute to strategic discussions around customer acquisition, retention, and brand growth
  • Perform additional duties as required to support business growth and evolving priorities

Process Development & Scalability

  • Build scalable frameworks and systems to support messaging consistency across 100+ SKUs
  • Develop SOPs, templates, and workflows for briefing, testing, and performance review processes
  • Help establish best practices for conversion strategy and creative performance across the organization
  • Support the long-term development of Triquetra’s conversion and creative strategy function

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Conversion Optimization (CRO), Ecommerce Growth, Performance Marketing, Copywriting, or Creative Strategy
  • Proven experience driving measurable conversion improvements across e-commerce or DTC brands
  • Strong copywriting and messaging strategy skills with a deep understanding of customer psychology
  • Experience translating technical, scientific, or complex products into simple, persuasive messaging
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and generate actionable insights
  • Experience running structured A/B testing and conversion optimization initiatives
  • Strong project management and prioritization skills in fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in supplements, wellness, healthcare, or consumer packaged goods (CPG)
  • Experience with Amazon marketplace optimization and listing conversion strategy
  • Experience in DTC e-commerce brands with multi-channel sales environments
  • Familiarity with tools such as Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, Google Analytics, heat mapping tools, and testing platforms
  • Experience working with creative teams, UGC creators, and paid media teams

Key Success Indicators

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Improvement in product page and listing conversion rates
  • Increase in revenue driven by messaging and conversion optimization initiatives
  • Improved consistency and clarity of messaging across channels
  • Quality and effectiveness of testing frameworks and creative briefs
  • Speed and quality of strategic insights delivered to the business

What Success Looks Like

A successful Conversion & Creative Strategist at Triquetra Health is someone who can quickly identify why messaging is not converting, develop stronger positioning, and build systems that consistently improve performance across channels.

This person combines strategic thinking, customer psychology, analytical rigor, and hands-on execution to turn product science into persuasive messaging that drives measurable growth.

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The Bilingual Loan Officer Assistant provides support to CrossCountry Mortgage, LLC’s (“CCM”) mortgage loan officers in their daily duties to increase loan production levels. The Bilingual Loan Officer Assistant works directly with CCM customers, loan officers, and processors to ensure a positive customer experience and facilitate timely loan closings.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Assist in reviewing mortgage loan application and documentation, which may include phone and computer work, printing, copying, scanning, emailing, overnighting documents, etc.
  • Review mortgage loan disclosure packages and deliver them to the borrower.
  • Create rate disclosure and re-disclosure packages and deliver them to the borrower.
  • Review documents and entire loan files and work to prevent problems by highlighting deficiencies and then notifying the mortgage loan officer and/or loan processor.
  • Clarify/correct information and obtain additional information, as necessary, via phone, email, etc.
  • General clerical and phone support to loan officers and/or loan processors, as needed.
  • Work with management to provide support in various stages and areas of lending and processing as needed.
  • Assist in managing a pipeline consisting of conventional, FHA, VA, and USDA loans, along with 203K and reverse mortgage products.
  • Deliver appraisals and/or property valuations to the borrower and retrieve proof of receipt.
  • Track outstanding items on all loan files and follow up with customers to ensure timely receipt of necessary documentation.
  • Facilitate timely loan closings by working directly with the Title Company and customer to schedule.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Fluency in the languages of Spanish and English in order to communicate effectively with internal and external customers, of whom may speak only English or Spanish.
  • High School Diploma, General Equivalency Diploma (GED), or equivalent.
  • A minimum of 1 year of mortgage-related experience, including customer contact.
  • Previous sales support experience, preferred.
  • Salesforce experience, preferred.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Excellent prioritization and time management skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications.

MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale. At MGID, we empower brands and publishers to collaborate transparently through our privacy-first targeting technology. This enables advertisers to drive performance and awareness while allowing publishers to retain and monetize their audiences. Today, we’re creating innovative technologies, and with your help, we aim to reach even greater heights.

We are looking for a Global Support Manager to join our team.

The Publisher Global Support Manager will be responsible for managing and developing relationships with existing publishers, maximizing revenue through account optimization and upselling, and minimizing churn. This role is essential to maintaining portfolio performance, ensuring publisher satisfaction, and achieving the team’s revenue and margin targets.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide timely and high-quality support to existing publishers.

  • Identify and resolve technical and operational issues.

  • Analyze publisher performance and implement optimizations to increase revenue.

  • Identify and execute upselling opportunities for MGID products.

  • Maintain accurate records of activities in HubSpot.

Requirements

Who You Are:

  • 1+ years of experience in digital advertising, account management, publisher support, or a related field.

  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, identify growth opportunities, and manage multiple accounts effectively.

  • Knowledge of digital advertising, website monetization, and key performance metrics (Revenue, RPM, CPM, Margin).

  • Experience with CRM systems (preferably HubSpot), data analysis, reporting, and account optimization.

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and results-oriented approach.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field is preferred.

It will be a plus:

  • Experience working with publishers, website owners, or advertising networks.

  • Understanding of programmatic advertising, Google Ad Manager, and AdSense.

  • Experience in website monetization and revenue optimization.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, Google Analytics, or similar tools.

  • Experience in upselling and identifying account growth opportunities.

  • Knowledge of additional foreign languages

Languages proficiency:

  • Ukrainian — fluent

  • English — fluent

MGID is an awesome place to work for those who share a results-driven culture, passion for AdTech, innovation, and human focus. We set ambitious goals, approach challenges with enthusiasm, and value honesty, transparency, and empathy. We celebrate the diversity and the unique contributions of each individual. By embracing these values, we create a culture of excellence, creativity, and empathy. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Bayswater Education was established in 2017 by a team of experienced professionals in the international education industry. The business is for profit, with a social mission at its core. Our one-for-one commitment means that for every week of tuition a student studies with us, we provide a week of education to underprivileged people in the markets from which our students are recruited.

We aim to inspire and educate the next generation through a global network of colleges, initially focused on English and French language courses for international students. Our offer also includes career-focused short courses, as well as summer and year-round group programmes.

Position Summary, Key Duties and Responsibilities

The Education Advisor is responsible for managing prospective student enquiries and supporting sales activity in the Brazilian and Colombian markets, with potential support for the wider Latin American market. The role requires excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence communicating by phone, and a courteous, professional approach when representing Bayswater Education.

  • Respond to sales enquiries received by phone, email, the website and marketing channels, including social media, Google Ads and online directories.
  • Understand prospective students’ needs and advise them on suitable courses, study destinations and the enrolment process.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the company CRM, including enquiry details, follow-up information, activities, tasks and sales outcomes.
  • Follow up with prospective students in a timely and organised manner, manage an active sales pipeline and work towards agreed targets.
  • Support marketing and business development activities to promote Bayswater Education and its schools in the Brazilian and Colombian markets, with potential support for the wider Latin American market.
  • Provide consistently excellent customer service to students and partners, resolving routine issues promptly and escalating matters when needed.
  • Follow agreed internal processes and procedures and collaborate with Direct Sales, Admissions, Marketing and school teams.
  • Contribute to a positive student journey by ensuring communications are clear, accurate, timely and professional.

Knowledge, Qualifications and Experience

  • Fluency in written and spoken English and Portuguese and Spanish.
  • Previous sales experience, ideally in the education industry, study-abroad sector or a related service environment.
  • Experience communicating with customers or students from different cultural backgrounds; international study or work experience is an advantage.
  • A third language is desirable: English proficiency beyond the required level, or another additional language, is an advantage.
  • An undergraduate degree in business, marketing, sales, languages, tourism or a related discipline is desirable.
  • Customer service experience is desirable.

Requirements: Knowledge, Qualifications and Experience

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build rapport and conduct effective sales conversations.
  • Well organised, accurate and able to manage a varied workload, multiple enquiries and follow-up deadlines.
  • Comfortable working towards goals and sales targets and managing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Confident using digital communication tools and CRM systems; previous CRM experience is an advantage.

Personal Attributes

  • Approachable, friendly, caring and customer-focused.
  • Resilient, flexible and proactive, with a positive, can-do approach.
  • Results-focused, self-motivated and committed to high standards.
  • A collaborative team player who can engage with a diverse range of people.
  • Committed to equality, diversity and continuous improvement, with a passion for delivering a memorable experience to students.

Legal Requirements

Eligibility to work as a contractor (freelancer) in the country of residence

Bayswater is committed to equality and diversity. Our initiatives and strategies are dedicated to develop, attract and advance the most talented individuals regardless of their race, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, disability status or any other dimension of diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity.

Salary: £10,000 annually + commission
