raw.description:
About the job Senior Finance Analyst

RMA Group is a multi-sector organization with more than 9,000 employees and an operational presence in 17 countries. For 40 years, we have developed enduring partnerships to support the needs of our clients, underpinned by the core values of Innovation, Integrity and Endurance. Through its various businesses including RMA Automotive, Global Fleet Sales, Comin Asia and Express Food Group (EFG), RMA Group has established itself as the partner of choice for leading automotive, equipment, engineering services, and food brands in Southeast Asia and beyond.

Overview and purpose of the role

The Senior Finance Analyst ensures accurate, timely financial reporting and provides insightful analysis to support decision-making across the Group's business divisions. The role acts as a finance business partner to division management, strengthens budgeting and forecasting, and supports Group, regulatory and audit reporting requirements.

﻿﻿Key responsibilities:
1. Accounting Close and Reporting
  • Coordinate with the Accounting team to ensure quality and timely account closing, both monthly and yearly.
  • Review trial balances, reconciliations and key journal entries to confirm accuracy before reports are issued.
  • Submit the monthly management report (P&L and Balance Sheet) to the GM, CFO and CEO, together with clear commentary on business performance.
  • Submit the monthly reporting package to the Group on schedule.
  • Produce regular weekly, monthly and yearly reports as required by management.
2. Analysis and Business Partnering
  • Act as finance business partner to divisions, supporting them on financial matters and on analytical tasks as requested.
  • Initiate reporting and analysis for divisions on a regular or as-required basis.
  • Perform variance analysis (actual vs. budget, forecast and prior period) on revenue, gross profit, operating expenses and cash flow, and explain key drivers and risks.
  • Analyze sales, margin, cost and working capital trends, and recommend actions to improve profitability and cash conversion.
  • Support commercial decisions such as pricing, investment proposals, capex and business cases with financial modelling.
3. Budgeting and Forecasting
  • Prepare the budget template and work with divisions to ensure budgets are produced on time and meet Group and company standards.
  • Prepare the required forecasts and rolling updates, and consolidate division inputs.
  • Monitor performance against budget throughout the year and highlight deviations early.
4. Statutory, Group and Regulatory Reporting
  • Assist in producing the quarterly and annual SECC reports.
  • Prepare the yearly consolidation pack (console pack) in line with Group requirements, including intercompany eliminations and reconciliations.
  • Support external audit and Group reviews by providing schedules, explanations and supporting documents.
5. Controls, Systems and Process Improvement
  • Support compliance with company accounting policies, Group standards and internal controls.
  • Work with the IT team on Odoo reporting needs by raising clear requests for fixes, improvements and new developments, and testing the results.
  • Ensure data integrity across systems and recommend ways to automate and standardize recurring reports and dashboards.
6. Team and Ad Hoc Support
  • Guide and review the work of junior finance staff where required.
  • Perform ad hoc tasks assigned by the manager, FC or CFO.
Background and experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field. A professional qualification (ACCA, CPA, CIMA or equivalent) is preferred.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in finance, financial analysis or accounting, ideally in a multi-division or group environment.
  • Experience with month-end close, management reporting, budgeting and consolidation.
  • Familiarity with Cambodian accounting standards (CIFRS) and regulatory reporting requirements, including SECC reporting, is an advantage.
  • Strong command of Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables, financial modelling) and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with an ERP system, preferably Odoo, and with BI or dashboard tools.
  • Solid understanding of financial statements, cost accounting and consolidation principles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, able to turn numbers into business commentary for non-finance managers.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines and work under pressure during closing periods.
  • Proactive, collaborative and comfortable working with several divisions.
  • High integrity and confidentiality.
  • Good English proficiency, written and spoken.

If you're interested, please send your CV to:

  • Email:
  • Telegram HR Contact Person:
  • Contact HR at: 070 790 890

﻿RMA Group is an equal opportunity employer, with a diverse group of colleagues globally representing different cultures, backgrounds, and beliefs. Our values of Innovation, Integrity and Endurance are embedded in what we do, and we welcome applicants who are committed to respecting diversity of thought, and in living our values on a day-to-day basis.

raw.description:
The best deals start with the right relationships. Build them.

Help connect independent sponsors with capital for established, profitable businesses. This is a relationship-first role for someone who understands finance, knows how to follow up without being pushy, and wants to build a smarter deal origination engine—not just chase meeting targets.

About the Company:

Private equity investment group connecting accredited investors with lower middle market acquisition opportunities. The firm provides equity capital to independent sponsors acquiring established, profitable businesses in resilient industries with durable demand. Its focus is on proven businesses, not startups or venture capital.

Location:Fully remote; open to candidates based in Latin America, South Africa, and Europe

Your Mission: Day to Day Responsibilities

  • Manage outreach replies, follow-ups, introductory calls, and long-term nurture with independent sponsors.

  • Research and connect with sponsors, M&A professionals, lenders, attorneys, and referral networks.

  • Understand investment strategies, assess initial fit, gather transaction details, and prepare concise internal handoffs.

  • Explain deal-by-deal private equity to suitable accredited investors using approved messaging—no hard selling or performance promises.

  • Keep CRM records accurate, track next steps, and make sure promising contacts never fall through the cracks.

  • Develop follow-up cadences, refine sourcing channels, and report on what generates meaningful relationships and qualified deals.

Success isn't about sending the most messages. It's about building trust, creating a pipeline of relevant opportunities, and making relationships compound over time.

Your Toolbox: Skills to be Successful

  • Around 2–5 years of relevant experience in finance, investing, lending, M&A, financial services, or financially sophisticated B2B business development. Demonstrated ability matters more than a specific career path.

  • Working familiarity with EBITDA, enterprise value, leverage, and equity financing.

  • Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, concise, professional communication style.

  • Excellent organization, CRM discipline, and follow-through.

  • Persistence without pressure, sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to qualify genuine opportunities.

  • A proactive mindset: you can research new audiences, test sourcing channels, and build processes without waiting for a playbook.

  • Comfort working independently in a lean, fast-moving environment.

Private equity expertise is a plus, not a prerequisite. You should already speak the language of business and finance, though.

Your Perks: What's in it for you

  • Base salary plus a defined performance bonus.

  • Shape the CRM, relationship-management process, sourcing strategy, and reporting systems.

  • Work closely with senior leadership in a lean team, without layers of management.

  • Progress from managing outreach and follow-ups to leading sponsor relationships and owning a meaningful part of the origination process.

The growth path: Learn the model and own the pipeline in month one; lead sponsor calls and nurture relationships in months two and three; become a trusted point of contact and improve the origination engine by months four to six.

A quick reality check: This isn't a high-volume SDR job, a pure investment-underwriting seat, or a role with a finished playbook. It's for someone who enjoys relationship building, operational detail, and creating opportunities over the long term.

Why Adaptive Teams?
At Adaptive Teams, we don’t just fill positions – we create pathways to success. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we’re here to help you grow, innovate, and make an impact. If you’re looking for exciting opportunities and, a team that’s as passionate as you are, this is the place to be.

What to Expect from Our Application Process?
Once you apply, you’ll receive an email guiding you through the next steps, including an assessment tailored to the role. Be sure to check your inbox (and your spam folder, just in case) for further instructions.

We understand your time is valuable, so we strive to keep the assessment process under 45 minutes whenever possible, though some roles may require a slightly longer time investment.

Once selected, you’ll have the chance to schedule your first interview with our team. We aim to make the process as smooth and transparent as possible, so you’ll always know where you stand.

The Role

We are hiring a senior client leader to own the post-sale customer journey across an international portfolio of commercial growers. The role combines leadership of Customer Success and related operational teams, strategic account management, enterprise implementation oversight and commercial expansion. Its purpose is to help customers turn the company's platform into an operationally valuable part of crop management, convert successful pilots and limited deployments into long-term scaled relationships, and build a consistently high standard of service across markets.

What You'll Do

  • Own customer health, retention and expansion across the portfolio; build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and personally lead strategic or at-risk accounts, resolving expectation gaps before they become commercial risks.
  • Lead, coach and set priorities for the Customer Success team, introducing structured account plans, customer health scoring and consistent service standards and reporting across markets.
  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process and the customer-facing quality of support, coordinating with Product, Engineering and the Senior Project Manager, and finding pragmatic solutions when a standard response isn't enough.
  • Oversee account administration, billing readiness and renewal or expansion forecasts, and represent the customer voice in product and management discussions.

What We Expect

  • Substantial hands-on experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, Key Account Manager or in a comparable client-management role for complex B2B digital products, IT solutions or technology-enabled projects, with demonstrated ownership of retention, renewals, expansion and senior customer relationships — including difficult conversations and recovery of at-risk accounts.
  • Strong command of professional customer-management methods — account and success plans, stakeholder mapping, customer journey design, health scoring, QBR or executive-review cadences, risk management and escalation frameworks — and practical experience with CRM, support and customer-success platforms, dashboards and playbooks.
  • At least two years of direct people-management experience, with responsibility for priorities, performance, coaching and development of customer-facing or related teams.
  • Demonstrated experience moving customers from pilot or proof of concept to multi-site, enterprise or otherwise scaled deployment, and strong understanding of business-process management — mapping, redesigning and embedding processes and controls.
  • Experience implementing digital products or IT systems for corporate customers, or leading an IT support or service-delivery function; ability to diagnose whether an issue is related to adoption, service, hardware, data or product capability and coordinate the right specialists without overpromising.
  • Strong commercial judgement working with contracts, subscriptions, billing, renewal dates and value or ROI discussions; fluent professional English for nuanced customer and executive conversations; willingness to travel internationally; strong organisation and attention to detail across multiple countries and parallel priorities.

Nice To Have

  • Knowledge of or experience in agriculture, commercial horticulture, protected cropping, integrated pest management, crop scouting, biological control or crop-protection technology, or relevant education in agronomy or horticulture.
  • Experience with computer vision, AI products, IoT or solutions that combine hardware, software and operational change.
  • Experience working across European and North American customers and cultures; Dutch or Russian language skills.

Candidate Profile

You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline. You can speak credibly with a grower in the greenhouse, challenge an internal team on a missed commitment, and then give management a concise, evidence-based view of risk and opportunity. You do not wait for customer dissatisfaction to become visible: you create clarity early, align stakeholders and follow through until the outcome is achieved.

raw.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

Do you thrive on being part of a team of highly skilled, ambitious people who are dedicated to achieving great things? We are a friendly team working to push our clients to the next level - learning new things, open to change and experimentation but always making sure commercial priorities and potential complexity are scoped as part of every decision.

We design, build and grow Shopify Plus stores that convert. From a team of 4 in 2016, to 60+ staff in 3 locations worldwide (Australia, France and the UK), we’re looking to bring additional experts into our team and see this role as a key part of our continued growth journey. We’ve been recognised as Shopify Plus Experts since the inception of the Plus program in 2016, and our clients work across a range of verticals, largely selling consumable products.

Project Managers play a key role at Swanky, communicating constantly with client teams and helping to coordinate and manage our expert teams. You will be joining the Australian team, working on large eCommerce projects with a particular focus on migrations to Shopify Plus.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • "They invest in their team and aim to provide assistance in growing and nurturing your skills."

Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

Our Company Values:

  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

The Project Manager, OSP Construction & Engineering is responsible for managing the quality, on-budget and timely completion of all construction projects across residential and commercial segments. The Project Manager, OSP Construction & Engineering will work closely with our vendor partners and will ensure adherence to all company and government guidelines.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Project Management and Delivery

·Responsible for the day-to-day management of projects using project management tools, processes, and methodologies to ensure projects are delivered on-time, on budget and with excellent quality. Serve as point of contact for everything involving a project’s organization and timeline.

·Create long and short-term plans, including setting targets for milestones and adhering to deadlines.

·Demonstrate consistent ownership and accountability for the delivery of projects.

Project Status, Documentation, and Reporting

·Maintain comprehensive project documentation and provide regular streamlined reports to leadership.

Communication, Coordination, and Resource Alignment

·Ensure that all team members have the required information and resources to carry out their tasks effectively.

·Coordinate with relevant internal team members to coordinate action items and realistic timelines to meet business goals.

·Coordinate and facilitate with internal and external resources to affect the timely completion of projects.

Risk Management and Issue Resolution

·Continuously perform risk assessment and resolve issues as they arise or quickly engage others to resolve to reduce adverse timing and quality impacts of the project schedule.

Process Improvement and Operational Efficiency

·Gather and provide feedback on lessons learned, best practices and innovations on process/procedures and tools to improve efficiencies and cycle time.

·Drive processes and automation to support LEAN process approaches to solve problems.

Other Duties

·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Minimum five (5) years of Telecommunication experience or equivalent project management experience.

·Experience managing large scale projects.

·Demonstrated experience meeting project commitment deadlines.

·Familiarity with Outside Plant (OSP) architectures consisting of underground, direct buried, aerial, and building applications.

  • Proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Adobe.
  • Understand LEAN concepts.

Preferred Qualifications:

·PMP certification

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to influence others to meet project objectives.

·Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.

·Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.

·Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail and organizational skills.

·Ability to work within critical deadlines.

·Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.

·Ability to provide excellent customer service.

·Effective conflict resolution skills.

·Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends when applicable to meet deadlines.

·Must be organized and accountable.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and multi-line telephone system. The work is primarily a modern office setting.

At all times, Ziply Fiber must be your primary employer. Unless otherwise prohibited by law, employees may not hold outside employment nor be self-employed without obtaining approval in writing from Ziply Fiber. In holding outside employment or self-employment, employees should ensure that participation does not conflict with responsibilities to Ziply Fiber or its business interests.

Diverse Workforce / EEO:

raw.description:
At Salted, we believe the future of restaurants doesn’t look anything like what we see today. The most successful brands will focus primarily on delivery and take-out - and use technology to nurture deep customer relationships that exist outside four walls.

Please note that we encourage candidates who are interested in this role to email us directly at with your resumé and a brief note about yourself and why you're a fit. Please include "Growth Manager" in the subject line. We read every one of these emails.

About the Role

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Growth Marketing Manager will manage the growth engine at Salted. You will think holistically about both top-line sales and bottom-line profitability across our entire portfolio of brands, with a focus on our flagship brand, moonbowls.

You're someone who loves to experiment, track performance, and figure out why things work (or why they didn't). This role sits at the intersection of marketplace management, direct-to-consumer (DTC) digital funnel optimization, retention marketing, and strategic growth opportunities. You will wear many hats, collaborate across teams (from Brand to Ops to Culinary), and adapt quickly as we scale from 40+ to 100+ locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Third-Party Marketplace Growth & Multivariate Testing: Work directly with the CEO to design and execute multivariate tests across major delivery platforms (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub). Optimize store presentation, menu architecture, photos, promotions, and ad placement to drive maximum conversion, order frequency, net profitability.
  • Web & Funnel Optimization: Own and optimize conversion funnels across brand websites, primarily moonbowls. Run continuous A/B tests on landing pages, checkout flows, and user experience to improve conversion rates and average order value (AOV).
  • Retention & Lifecycle Marketing: Partner closely with our Head of Brand Marketing to build, test, and scale automated drip campaigns across email and SMS. Focus on key metrics like retention, customer lifetime value (LTV), repeat order frequency, and win-backs.
  • Holistic Funnel Strategy: Treat every customer touchpoint—from digital ads to our physical storefronts to packaging —as part of a unified growth engine.
  • Data & Analytics Mastery: Analyze channel performance, customer cohorts, menu conversion metrics, and promotional margins. Uncover trends, diagnose funnel leaks, and translate data into actionable growth initiatives.
  • White Space & Market Expansion: Collaborate with Culinary and Operations teams to advise on market opportunities and menu expansion based on consumer demand trends and performance data.
  • Scale & Cascade: Develop growth playbooks for moonbowls and cascade winning frameworks across our portfolio of brands.
  • Salted-Operated Locations: Maximize the customer experience and growth potential at our physical storefronts. Work cross-functionally to optimize the pickup experience, in-store branding, and hospitality touchpoints to turn one-time pickup customers into recurring first-party digital orderers.
  • Catering Growth & Acquisition Funnel: Treat catering as a primary top-of-funnel acquisition channel. Collaborate with our Business Development team to test campaigns that convert high-value corporate/group catering clients into loyal customer accounts.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on growth experience in DTC, food-tech, delivery platform marketing, or e-commerce.
  • Data-driven & obsessed with economics: You care about customer frequency, net margins and net payouts - not just top-line vanity metrics.
  • AI-proficiency: You are comfortable using AI to solve problems and are constantly looking for ways to accelerate great work - without sacrificing accuracy and authenticity.
  • Marketing stack experience: Hands-on experience with web analytics tools, A/B testing platforms, and lifecycle marketing platforms
  • Scrappy & adaptable: Comfortable moving between high-level strategic growth planning and rolling up your sleeves to execute day-to-day optimizations.
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator: Ability to partner effectively with stakeholders across departments.
  • LA-based: Ideally based in LA (although not a requirement).

Benefits

• Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

• Retirement Plan (401k)

• Stock Options

• Career Advancement Opportunities
• Work with a team that’s transforming the restaurant industry

raw.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

As Director of GTM Operations, you’ll own the planning, analytics, and operating rhythm that connect our go-to-market strategy to execution across Sales and Marketing. You’ll lead a small team, including an analyst and a project manager, and use data, AI, and research to shape GTM decisions, keep teams aligned, and drive measurable revenue impact.

GTM Strategy & Planning

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Finance to build and operationalize the annual growth plan: pipeline and bookings targets, capacity, headcount, and budget.

  • Lead GTM strategy for new products and verticals, pricing and packaging changes, and market expansion.

  • Build segmentation and coverage models that focus reps on the highest-value opportunities and improve productivity.

  • Turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for Sales leadership.

Campaign Operations & Governance

  • Run the campaign operating rhythm: governance, meeting cadences, decision rights, and follow-through.

  • Own campaign dashboards that track milestones, owners, risks, and dependencies, and escalate blockers with a recommended path forward.

  • Build repeatable launch playbooks covering CRM configuration, workflows, reporting, and sales enablement.

Sales & Marketing Alignment

  • Define and enforce the marketing-to-sales handoff (lead routing, follow-up SLAs, and rules of engagement), partnering with CRM, Systems, and Engineering on the process and system design behind it.

  • Align campaigns, lists, and messaging with sales workflows and pipeline priorities.

  • Run feedback loops so Sales and Marketing operate as one team.

AI, Automation & Process Innovation

  • Identify, pilot, and scale AI and automation across prospecting, lead scoring, deal support, and rep workflows.

  • Track emerging AI-native GTM tools and bring what’s proven into the team’s playbook.

Team Leadership

Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance – Insurance & Investments

About the Role

The Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance is a senior enterprise-level finance executive responsible for providing strategic and operational financial leadership across the Group's insurance, investment, asset management, and related financial services businesses.

The EVP Finance will work closely with the Group CFO, CEO, Board, business-unit CEOs, investment leadership, and senior executives to strengthen financial performance, capital efficiency, profitability, governance, risk management, and long-term enterprise value.

Key Responsibilities

Lead enterprise-wide financial strategy, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Provide executive oversight of financial performance across subsidiaries, business units, and investment platforms.

Drive Group-wide FP&A, management reporting, financial modelling, and commercial finance.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, margins, cash flow, ROE, ROIC, and return on capital.

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability.

Provide financial leadership for investment and asset management businesses, including portfolio reporting, valuation, investment income, performance analysis, and cost management.

Lead strategic capital planning, capital allocation, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet optimization.

Provide executive oversight of treasury, funding, cash management, and liquidity planning.

Establish and strengthen Group-wide financial governance, internal controls, accounting policies, and risk-management frameworks.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting requirements.

Lead financial evaluation and due diligence for M&A, acquisitions, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and market expansion.

Partner with the Investment, Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, and Operations functions on major strategic and financial decisions.

Drive enterprise-wide cost optimization, operational efficiency, and profitability improvement.

Lead finance transformation, including ERP modernization, automation, AI/data analytics, dashboards, and digital finance initiatives.

Maintain senior relationships with regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, rating agencies, and other financial stakeholders.

Provide high-level financial advice to the CEO, Group CFO, Board, and Executive Committee.

Build a strong succession pipeline and lead senior finance executives across the organization.

Support the development and execution of the Group's long-term growth and value-creation strategy.

Strategic KPIs

Group revenue and earnings growth

EBITDA / operating profit

ROE, ROIC, and return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Insurance underwriting profitability

Budget and forecast accuracy

Cost-to-income and expense efficiency

Liquidity and treasury performance

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

M&A and strategic investment returns

Regulatory and audit performance

Finance transformation and automation

Shareholder and enterprise value creation

Candidate Profile

18–25+ years of progressive finance experience, preferably within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, reinsurance, pensions, or diversified financial services.

Extensive experience in enterprise-level, Group, regional, or multi-entity finance leadership.

Previous experience as EVP Finance, Executive Vice President Finance, Group Finance Director, Group CFO, CFO, SVP Finance, Finance Director, Deputy Group CFO, or equivalent.

Strong understanding of insurance finance, investment finance, capital management, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory requirements.

Demonstrated experience managing complex organizations with multiple subsidiaries, business lines, and jurisdictions.

Strong commercial understanding of investments, financial markets, capital allocation, and enterprise performance.

Proven track record in M&A, capital raising, strategic investments, restructuring, or major transformation initiatives.

Extensive experience engaging with Boards, CEOs, regulators, investors, auditors, and other senior stakeholders.

Proven ability to lead large, geographically dispersed finance organizations.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

Additional qualifications in insurance, investments, risk, actuarial science, or financial management are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Enterprise Finance Strategy | Group Financial Management | FP&A | Financial Reporting | Insurance Finance | Investment Finance | Capital Allocation | Treasury | Solvency | Balance-Sheet Management | M&A | Financial Modelling | Risk Management | Governance | Regulatory Compliance | Cost Optimization | Finance Transformation | Executive Leadership

Leadership Characteristics

Exceptional strategic and commercial judgment

Strong executive presence

Enterprise-wide perspective

High integrity and governance orientation

Strong analytical and decision-making capability

Excellent Board and stakeholder communication

Results-driven and financially disciplined

Transformational and innovation-oriented

Strong talent-development and succession-planning capability

Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multinational environments

raw.description:
Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O’Brien, is seeking an experienced Electrical Design Production Lead to lead the design of complex electrical systems for hyperscale and AI data centres across North America. This is a remote position within an international engineering firm recognized for its innovation and expertise in mission-critical infrastructure.

Our projects involve large-scale, high-demand facilities with complex structural, electrical, mechanical, automation, and security systems, often exceeding 100 MW per facility and up to 500 MW per site.

The Electrical Design Production Lead is a hands-on role focused on electrical design production, coordination, and quality control. This position is ideal for a mid-level to experienced professional with a strong production background who enjoys being deeply involved in detailed design work rather than operating purely in a senior or strategic oversight capacity. The role primarily supports internal project teams by ensuring high-quality, well-coordinated electrical design deliverablesand is not designed as a traditional people-management or client-ownership role.

WhatWe Offer:

  • Experience in a high-tech industry within an international company
  • Unique, cutting-edge data center projects
  • Comprehensive training
  • Professional development support
  • Supportive management and a dynamic team environment
  • Career growth potential
  • Ability to work from home
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • Competitive employee benefits: Health insurance, Life insurance, Short-term and long-term disability, many other benefits, including PTO.
  • Opportunity to participate in the company’s retirement plan
  • Stock ownership / synthetic equity options

What You Will Do:

  • Coordinate and manage electrical design production across multiple project teams within the data centre sector
  • Collaborate closely with electrical engineers, architects, project managers, designers, BIM modelers, and other disciplines to ensure coordinated and high-quality deliverables
  • Actively participate in hands-on electrical design and production work using Revit and other electrical design and coordination software
  • Develop, update, and maintain electrical models and drawings throughout all project phases
  • Review electrical drawings at all project stages, including IFP, IFC, permit, and construction documents
  • Perform detailed quality control checks and comprehensive design reviews
  • Break down production tasks, assign work, and manage resources effectively to meet project schedules
  • Support project teams with documentation review and issue resolution using project management and collaboration tools
  • Participate in client calls as needed to support coordination and communication (not acting as the primary client lead)

What We Expect:

Core qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university
  • 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in electrical design, production, or coordination, preferably in the construction industry
  • Strong proficiency in Revit is a critical requirement (daily use in production and coordination)
  • Solid understanding of electrical design workflows, tools, and production processes

Technical experience

  • Strong understanding of electrical systems design, including:
  • Power distribution systems
  • UPS systems and standby generators
  • Life safety, monitoring, and security systems
  • Familiarity with NEC, applicablecodes, standards, and safety regulations
  • Practical experience on commercial, healthcare, industrial, or comparable complex building projects

Tools & platforms (nice to have)

  • Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, and Revizto is a plus
  • PE license is not required, but considered an asset

Working style & soft skills & other

  • Strong attention to detail, commitment to quality, and coordination
  • Ability to coordinate and support production workflows effectively across multiple teams
  • Strong communication skills for internal teams and occasional client interactions
  • Optional site visits if desired (no required travel)
  • Authorization to work in Canada

Join Us:

Our commitment to innovation drives us to deliver superior services to our clients using advanced tools and software.

We offer a dynamic environment fostering creativity through exposure to diverse technologies and experiences, ranging from designing energy-efficient facilities and site supervision for multi-million-dollar facilities to the production of digital twins, three-dimensional building modeling, computational fluid dynamics, and the development of custom controls software.

Join our team at Ehvert Mission Critical, now a proud part of Salas O'Brien, and help us achieve our international engineering goals!

For more information, visit Ehvert and Salas O'Brien.

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Norwell, Massachusetts

Salary:

135K - 160K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $135,000 – $160,000 / year
